#include "core/device.h"
#include "core/window.h"
#include "app/gui.h"
#include "helpers/screenshot.h"

#include <windows.h>
#include <thread>
#include <chrono>

#include "theme/layout.h"
#include "imgui.h"
#include "imgui_impl_dx11.h"
#include "imgui_impl_win32.h"

// ── SILK ESP Integration ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#include "esp/emu_connect.hpp"
#include "esp/esp_overlay.hpp"
#include "esp/Cheat/Data/Data.hpp"

static HMODULE g_dll_instance = nullptr;

static DWORD WINAPI ui_thread(LPVOID)
{
    // Allow the emulator process a short moment to finish loading
    Sleep(800);

    // ── Connect to emulator (BstkVMM hook + ADB root) ─────────────────────────
    // Note: Data::Work() runs synchronously inside esp_overlay::frame() on this
    // UI thread (exactly as designed in SILK) to prevent multithread data races.
    emu_connect::start();
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    ImGui_ImplWin32_EnableDpiAwareness();

    WNDCLASSEXW wc = { sizeof(wc), CS_CLASSDC, app_wnd_proc, 0L, 0L,
        g_dll_instance ? g_dll_instance : GetModuleHandle(nullptr), nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr,
        L"ImguiPortfolio14Shell", nullptr };
    ::RegisterClassExW(&wc);

    GfxShared shared = {};
    if (!gfx_create_shared(shared))
    {
        gfx_destroy_shared(shared);
        ::UnregisterClassW(wc.lpszClassName, wc.hInstance);
        return 1;
    }

    AppSurface surface = {};

    const int win_w = ::GetSystemMetrics(SM_CXSCREEN);
    const int win_h = ::GetSystemMetrics(SM_CYSCREEN);

    HWND hwnd = ::CreateWindowExW(
        WS_EX_NOREDIRECTIONBITMAP | WS_EX_LAYERED | WS_EX_TOPMOST,
        wc.lpszClassName, L"Imgui Portifolio #15", WS_POPUP,
        0, 0, win_w, win_h,
        nullptr, nullptr, wc.hInstance, nullptr);

    if (hwnd)
    {
        ::SetLayeredWindowAttributes(hwnd, 0, 255, LWA_ALPHA);
        ::SetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWLP_USERDATA, reinterpret_cast<LONG_PTR>(&surface));
    }

    if (!hwnd || !gfx_create_surface(shared, surface, hwnd))
    {
        gfx_destroy_surface(surface);
        gfx_destroy_shared(shared);
        ::UnregisterClassW(wc.lpszClassName, wc.hInstance);
        return 1;
    }

    ::ShowWindow(hwnd, SW_SHOWDEFAULT);
    ::UpdateWindow(hwnd);

    IMGUI_CHECKVERSION();
    ImGui::CreateContext();
    ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
    io.IniFilename = nullptr;
    io.LogFilename = nullptr;

    ImGui_ImplWin32_Init(hwnd);
    ImGui_ImplDX11_Init(shared.device, shared.context);
    gui::initialize(shared.device);

    surface.imgui_win32_route   = true;
    surface.quit_app_on_destroy = false; // NEVER quit emulator process on UI destroy

    bool done = false;
    while (!done)
    {
        MSG msg;
        while (::PeekMessage(&msg, nullptr, 0U, 0U, PM_REMOVE))
        {
            ::TranslateMessage(&msg);
            ::DispatchMessage(&msg);
            if (msg.message == WM_QUIT)
                done = true;
        }
        if (done) break;

        // Toggle UI with INSERT key
        static bool insert_down = false;
        if (GetAsyncKeyState(VK_INSERT) & 0x8000)
        {
            if (!insert_down)
            {
                insert_down = true;
                gui::g_menu_open = !gui::g_menu_open;

                LONG_PTR ex = ::GetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWL_EXSTYLE);
                if (gui::g_menu_open)
                {
                    // Menu is OPEN -> allow mouse clicks on menu panel
                    ex &= ~WS_EX_TRANSPARENT;
                }
                else
                {
                    // Menu is HIDDEN -> 100% click-through to Discord, Desktop, BlueStacks, etc.
                    ex |= WS_EX_TRANSPARENT;
                }
                ::SetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWL_EXSTYLE, ex);
                ::SetWindowPos(hwnd, nullptr, 0, 0, 0, 0, SWP_NOMOVE | SWP_NOSIZE | SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_FRAMECHANGED);
            }
        }
        else
        {
            insert_down = false;
        }

        unsigned rw = 0, rh = 0;
        if (app_surface_consume_resize(surface, rw, rh))
            gfx_resize_surface(shared, surface, rw, rh);

        // Render SILK ESP overlay attached to the emulator window
        esp_overlay::frame(g_dll_instance, shared.device, shared.context);

        ImGui_ImplDX11_NewFrame();
        ImGui_ImplWin32_NewFrame();
        app_update_io_for_hwnd(hwnd, io);
        screenshot::begin_frame();
        gui::prepare_frame();
        ImGui::NewFrame();

        gui::render(hwnd);

        ImGui::Render();
        gfx_render_surface(shared, surface, ImGui::GetDrawData());
    }

    gui::shutdown();
    ImGui_ImplDX11_Shutdown();
    ImGui_ImplWin32_Shutdown();
    ImGui::DestroyContext();

    gfx_destroy_surface(surface);
    gfx_destroy_shared(shared);
    ::DestroyWindow(hwnd);
    ::UnregisterClassW(wc.lpszClassName, wc.hInstance);
    return 0;
}

BOOL APIENTRY DllMain(HMODULE hModule, DWORD ul_reason_for_call, LPVOID lpReserved)
{
    if (ul_reason_for_call == DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH)
    {
        g_dll_instance = hModule;
        ::DisableThreadLibraryCalls(hModule);
        ::CreateThread(nullptr, 0, ui_thread, nullptr, 0, nullptr);
    }
    return TRUE;
}

#include "gui.h"

#include "helpers/fonts.h"
#include "helpers/texture_cache.h"
#include "helpers/window_drag.h"
#include "pages/login_page.h"

namespace
{
    main_page::state  g_main;
    login_page::state g_login;

    ImGuiStyle g_base_style = {};
    bool g_base_style_saved = false;

    // Smooth UI scaling state
    float g_smooth_scale = 1.0f;

    // Track active panel boundaries for WM_NCHITTEST pass-through
    ImRect g_active_panel_rect = {};
    ImRect g_active_popup_rect = {};
    bool   g_has_open_popup    = false;

    // Page transition animation (0 = login, 1 = main dashboard)
    float g_view_transition = 0.f;

    void apply_style()
    {
        ImGuiStyle& s = ImGui::GetStyle();
        s.WindowRounding   = 0.f;
        s.WindowBorderSize = 0.f;
        s.WindowPadding    = { 0.f, 0.f };
        s.AntiAliasedLines = true;
        s.AntiAliasedFill  = true;
        s.ChildBorderSize  = 0.f;
        s.FrameBorderSize  = 0.f;
        s.ScrollbarSize    = 0.f;

        ImVec4* c = s.Colors;
        c[ImGuiCol_WindowBg] = { 0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.f };
        c[ImGuiCol_Text]     = colors::text;

        if (!g_base_style_saved)
        {
            g_base_style = s;
            g_base_style_saved = true;
        }
    }
}

namespace gui
{
    void initialize(ID3D11Device* device)
    {
        colors::sync_accent_hover();
        fonts::init();
        apply_style();
        texture_cache::init(device);

        // Pre-fill demo credentials so user can log in with 1 click or type their own
        strncpy_s(g_login.username, "Admin", sizeof(g_login.username));
        strncpy_s(g_login.password, "password123", sizeof(g_login.password));
    }

    void shutdown()
    {
        fonts::shutdown();
        texture_cache::shutdown();
    }

    void prepare_frame()
    {
        const ImVec2 display = ImGui::GetIO().DisplaySize;
        const float dt = ImGui::GetIO().DeltaTime;

        // Smoothly interpolate user_scale for silky-smooth resizing
        g_smooth_scale += (ui_scale::user_scale - g_smooth_scale) * ImMin(1.f, dt * 16.f);

        ui_scale::factor = (layout::panel_w / layout::panel_design) * g_smooth_scale;
        fonts::sync_ui_scale(ui_scale::factor);

        ImGui::GetStyle() = g_base_style;
        ImGui::GetStyle().ScaleAllSizes(ui_scale::factor);
    }

    bool is_point_inside(float x, float y)
    {
        if (!g_menu_open)
            return false;

        const ImVec2 pt(x, y);
        if (g_active_panel_rect.Contains(pt))
            return true;
        if (g_has_open_popup && g_active_popup_rect.Contains(pt))
            return true;
        return false;
    }

    void render(HWND hwnd)
    {
        if (!g_menu_open)
            return;

        const ImVec2 display = ImGui::GetIO().DisplaySize;
        const float dt = ImGui::GetIO().DeltaTime;

        // Golden modern aspect ratio: slightly narrower width, taller height
        const float w = ui_scale::s(layout::panel_w); // 440
        const float h = ui_scale::s(layout::panel_h); // 560

        // Keep panel position and allow smooth dragging
        static ImVec2 panel_pos = { -1.f, -1.f };
        if (panel_pos.x < 0.f || panel_pos.y < 0.f)
            panel_pos = { (display.x - w) * 0.5f, (display.y - h) * 0.5f };

        // Keep inside screen bounds
        if (panel_pos.x < 0.f) panel_pos.x = 0.f;
        if (panel_pos.y < 0.f) panel_pos.y = 0.f;
        if (panel_pos.x + w > display.x && display.x > w) panel_pos.x = display.x - w;
        if (panel_pos.y + h > display.y && display.y > h) panel_pos.y = display.y - h;

        const ImRect panel_bb(panel_pos, panel_pos + ImVec2(w, h));
        const float panel_round = ui_scale::s(layout::shell_round);

        // Update active panel bounds for pass-through hit testing
        const ImVec2 bp_min = panel_bb.Min + ImVec2(ui_scale::s(28.f), ui_scale::s(40.f));
        const ImVec2 bp_max = panel_bb.Min + ImVec2(ui_scale::s(layout::panel_w - 28.f), ui_scale::s(layout::panel_h - 40.f));
        g_active_panel_rect = ImRect(bp_min, bp_max);

        // Check if a popup is active in main_page
        g_has_open_popup = (g_main.open_popup != 0);
        if (g_has_open_popup)
        {
            // Popups 1..11 pop out to the right of the panel
            const float pop_w = ui_scale::s(220.f);
            g_active_popup_rect = ImRect(bp_max.x, bp_min.y, bp_max.x + pop_w + ui_scale::s(20.f), bp_max.y);
        }

        ImGui::SetNextWindowPos({ 0.f, 0.f }, ImGuiCond_Always);
        ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(display, ImGuiCond_Always);

        ImGui::Begin(layout::main_window_id, nullptr,
            ImGuiWindowFlags_NoTitleBar | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoResize |
            ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMove     | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoScrollbar |
            ImGuiWindowFlags_NoCollapse | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoSavedSettings |
            ImGuiWindowFlags_NoBackground);

        ImDrawList* dl = ImGui::GetWindowDrawList();

        // Outer smooth subtle dark shadow for floating window depth
        for (int i = 4; i >= 1; --i)
        {
            const float shadow_off = (float)i * ui_scale::s(2.5f);
            dl->AddRectFilled(bp_min - ImVec2(shadow_off, shadow_off),
                              bp_max + ImVec2(shadow_off, shadow_off),
                              ImGui::GetColorU32(ImVec4(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.04f * (5 - i))),
                              panel_round + shadow_off);
        }

        // Draw the dark sleek GUI container window
        dl->AddRectFilled(bp_min, bp_max, ImGui::GetColorU32(colors::bg), panel_round);
        dl->AddRect(bp_min, bp_max, ImGui::GetColorU32(colors::divider), panel_round, 0, ui_scale::s(1.0f));

        // Smooth View Transition between Login and Main Dashboard
        const float target_transition = g_login.is_logged_in ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
        g_view_transition += (target_transition - g_view_transition) * ImMin(1.f, dt * 10.f);

        bool blocks_drag = false;

        // Render Login View if not fully transitioned to main
        if (g_view_transition < 0.999f)
        {
            g_login.page_alpha = 1.0f - g_view_transition;
            login_page::draw(panel_bb, g_login, blocks_drag);
        }

        // Render Main Dashboard View when transition begins
        if (g_view_transition > 0.001f)
        {
            main_page::draw(panel_bb, g_main, blocks_drag);
        }

        // Allow smooth dragging from the top header area of the panel
        const ImRect top_header(bp_min, ImVec2(bp_max.x - ui_scale::s(60.f), bp_min.y + ui_scale::s(48.f)));
        window_drag::handle_panel(panel_pos, top_header, blocks_drag);

        if (g_main.exit_pressed || g_login.exit_pressed)
            ::PostQuitMessage(0);

        (void)blocks_drag;
        (void)hwnd;
        ImGui::End();
    }
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\91xb6k7\framework\core\backdrop.cpp ===== 
#include "backdrop.h"

#include <dwmapi.h>

#pragma comment(lib, "dwmapi.lib")

#ifndef DWMWA_SYSTEMBACKDROP_TYPE
#define DWMWA_SYSTEMBACKDROP_TYPE 38
#endif
#ifndef DWMWA_MICA_EFFECT
#define DWMWA_MICA_EFFECT 1029
#endif
#ifndef DWMSBT_MAINWINDOW
#define DWMSBT_MAINWINDOW 2
#endif
#ifndef DWMSBT_TRANSIENTWINDOW
#define DWMSBT_TRANSIENTWINDOW 3
#endif

enum ACCENT_STATE
{
    ACCENT_DISABLED                 = 0,
    ACCENT_ENABLE_BLURBEHIND        = 3,
    ACCENT_ENABLE_ACRYLICBLURBEHIND = 4,
};

struct ACCENT_POLICY
{
    int   AccentState;
    int   AccentFlags;
    DWORD GradientColor;
    int   AnimationId;
};

enum WINDOWCOMPOSITIONATTRIB { WCA_ACCENT_POLICY = 19 };

struct WINDOWCOMPOSITIONATTRIBDATA
{
    WINDOWCOMPOSITIONATTRIB Attrib;
    PVOID                   pvData;
    SIZE_T                  cbData;
};

using SetWindowCompositionAttribute_t = BOOL(WINAPI*)(HWND, WINDOWCOMPOSITIONATTRIBDATA*);

namespace
{
    void extend_glass(HWND hwnd)
    {
        const MARGINS margins = { -1, -1, -1, -1 };
        ::DwmExtendFrameIntoClientArea(hwnd, &margins);
    }

    bool try_win11_backdrop(HWND hwnd)
    {
        BOOL dark = TRUE;
        ::DwmSetWindowAttribute(hwnd, DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE, &dark, sizeof(dark));

        const int backdrop = DWMSBT_TRANSIENTWINDOW;
        if (SUCCEEDED(::DwmSetWindowAttribute(hwnd, DWMWA_SYSTEMBACKDROP_TYPE, &backdrop, sizeof(backdrop))))
            return true;

        const BOOL mica = TRUE;
        return SUCCEEDED(::DwmSetWindowAttribute(hwnd, DWMWA_MICA_EFFECT, &mica, sizeof(mica)));
    }

    void apply_win10_acrylic(HWND hwnd)
    {
        HMODULE user32 = ::GetModuleHandleW(L"user32.dll");
        if (!user32)
            return;

        auto fn = reinterpret_cast<SetWindowCompositionAttribute_t>(
            ::GetProcAddress(user32, "SetWindowCompositionAttribute"));
        if (!fn)
            return;

        ACCENT_POLICY policy = {};
        policy.AccentState   = ACCENT_ENABLE_ACRYLICBLURBEHIND;
        policy.AccentFlags   = 2;
        policy.GradientColor = 0x8018181C;

        WINDOWCOMPOSITIONATTRIBDATA data = {};
        data.Attrib = WCA_ACCENT_POLICY;
        data.pvData = &policy;
        data.cbData = sizeof(policy);
        fn(hwnd, &data);
    }
}

void backdrop_apply(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (!hwnd)
        return;

    extend_glass(hwnd);
    if (!try_win11_backdrop(hwnd))
        apply_win10_acrylic(hwnd);
}

void backdrop_remove(HWND hwnd)
{
    if (!hwnd)
        return;

    const int backdrop = DWMSBT_MAINWINDOW;
    ::DwmSetWindowAttribute(hwnd, DWMWA_SYSTEMBACKDROP_TYPE, &backdrop, sizeof(backdrop));

    HMODULE user32 = ::GetModuleHandleW(L"user32.dll");
    if (!user32)
        return;

    auto fn = reinterpret_cast<SetWindowCompositionAttribute_t>(
        ::GetProcAddress(user32, "SetWindowCompositionAttribute"));
    if (!fn)
        return;

    ACCENT_POLICY policy = {};
    policy.AccentState = ACCENT_DISABLED;

    WINDOWCOMPOSITIONATTRIBDATA data = {};
    data.Attrib = WCA_ACCENT_POLICY;
    data.pvData = &policy;
    data.cbData = sizeof(policy);
    fn(hwnd, &data);
}

#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#include <windows.h>
#include <d3d11.h>
#include <dxgi1_2.h>
#include <dcomp.h>

#include "device.h"
#include "glow_renderer.h"
#include "../helpers/screenshot.h"
#include "imgui.h"
#include "imgui_impl_dx11.h"
#include "../theme/colors.h"

#pragma comment(lib, "dxgi.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "dcomp.lib")

bool gfx_create_shared(GfxShared& out)
{
    const UINT create_flags = D3D11_CREATE_DEVICE_BGRA_SUPPORT;
    const D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL levels[] = { D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL_11_0, D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL_10_0 };
    D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL level = {};

    HRESULT hr = D3D11CreateDevice(nullptr, D3D_DRIVER_TYPE_HARDWARE, nullptr, create_flags,
        levels, 2, D3D11_SDK_VERSION, &out.device, &level, &out.context);

    if (hr == DXGI_ERROR_UNSUPPORTED)
    {
        hr = D3D11CreateDevice(nullptr, D3D_DRIVER_TYPE_WARP, nullptr, create_flags,
            levels, 2, D3D11_SDK_VERSION, &out.device, &level, &out.context);
    }

    return SUCCEEDED(hr);
}

void gfx_destroy_shared(GfxShared& shared)
{
    if (shared.context) { shared.context->Release(); shared.context = nullptr; }
    if (shared.device)  { shared.device->Release();  shared.device  = nullptr; }
}

bool gfx_create_surface(GfxShared& shared, AppSurface& surface, HWND hwnd)
{
    surface.hwnd = hwnd;

    RECT rc = {};
    ::GetClientRect(hwnd, &rc);
    const UINT width  = (UINT)max(rc.right  - rc.left, 1);
    const UINT height = (UINT)max(rc.bottom - rc.top,  1);

    IDXGIDevice*   dxgi_device = nullptr;
    IDXGIAdapter*  adapter     = nullptr;
    IDXGIFactory2* factory     = nullptr;

    if (FAILED(shared.device->QueryInterface(IID_PPV_ARGS(&dxgi_device)))) return false;
    if (FAILED(dxgi_device->GetAdapter(&adapter)))                          return false;
    if (FAILED(adapter->GetParent(IID_PPV_ARGS(&factory))))                 return false;

    DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_DESC1 sd = {};
    sd.Width       = width;
    sd.Height      = height;
    sd.Format      = DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM;
    sd.SampleDesc.Count = 1;
    sd.BufferUsage = DXGI_USAGE_RENDER_TARGET_OUTPUT;
    sd.BufferCount = 2;
    sd.SwapEffect  = DXGI_SWAP_EFFECT_FLIP_SEQUENTIAL;
    sd.AlphaMode   = DXGI_ALPHA_MODE_PREMULTIPLIED;

    HRESULT hr = factory->CreateSwapChainForComposition(shared.device, &sd, nullptr, &surface.swap_chain);
    if (FAILED(hr)) return false;

    if (FAILED(DCompositionCreateDevice(dxgi_device, IID_PPV_ARGS(&surface.dcomp_device)))) return false;
    if (FAILED(surface.dcomp_device->CreateTargetForHwnd(hwnd, TRUE, &surface.dcomp_target))) return false;
    if (FAILED(surface.dcomp_device->CreateVisual(&surface.dcomp_visual))) return false;

    surface.dcomp_visual->SetContent(surface.swap_chain);
    surface.dcomp_target->SetRoot(surface.dcomp_visual);
    surface.dcomp_device->Commit();

    factory->Release();
    adapter->Release();
    dxgi_device->Release();

    gfx_resize_surface(shared, surface, width, height);
    return true;
}

void gfx_destroy_surface(AppSurface& surface)
{
    if (surface.render_target) { surface.render_target->Release(); surface.render_target = nullptr; }
    if (surface.swap_chain)    { surface.swap_chain->Release();    surface.swap_chain    = nullptr; }
    if (surface.dcomp_visual)  { surface.dcomp_visual->Release();  surface.dcomp_visual  = nullptr; }
    if (surface.dcomp_target)  { surface.dcomp_target->Release();  surface.dcomp_target  = nullptr; }
    if (surface.dcomp_device)  { surface.dcomp_device->Release();  surface.dcomp_device  = nullptr; }
    surface.hwnd = nullptr;
}

void gfx_resize_surface(GfxShared& shared, AppSurface& surface, unsigned width, unsigned height)
{
    if (!surface.swap_chain) return;

    if (surface.render_target)
    {
        surface.render_target->Release();
        surface.render_target = nullptr;
    }

    if (width > 0 && height > 0)
        surface.swap_chain->ResizeBuffers(0, width, height, DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN, 0);

    ID3D11Texture2D* back_buffer = nullptr;
    surface.swap_chain->GetBuffer(0, IID_PPV_ARGS(&back_buffer));
    if (back_buffer)
    {
        shared.device->CreateRenderTargetView(back_buffer, nullptr, &surface.render_target);
        back_buffer->Release();
    }
}

void gfx_render_surface(GfxShared& shared, AppSurface& surface, ImDrawData* draw_data)
{
    if (!draw_data || !surface.render_target) return;

    screenshot::state& ss = screenshot::get();
    float clear[4] = { 0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.f };
    shared.context->OMSetRenderTargets(1, &surface.render_target, nullptr);
    shared.context->ClearRenderTargetView(surface.render_target, clear);

    glow_renderer::flush(shared.context, draw_data->DisplaySize);
    glow_renderer::clear_queue();

    ImGui_ImplDX11_RenderDrawData(draw_data);

    if (ss.capture_frame && ss.bounds_valid)
    {
        screenshot::capture_and_save(shared.device, shared.context, surface.render_target,
            ss.bounds_min, ss.bounds_max);
        ss.capture_frame = false;
        ss.bounds_valid  = false;
    }

    if (surface.swap_chain)   surface.swap_chain->Present(1, 0);
    if (surface.dcomp_device) surface.dcomp_device->Commit();
}
 
 
===== FILE: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\91xb6k7\framework\core\glow_renderer.cpp ===== 
#include "glow_renderer.h"

#include <d3d11.h>
#include <d3dcompiler.h>
#include <cstring>
#include <vector>

#pragma comment(lib, "d3dcompiler.lib")

namespace
{
    struct GlowCB
    {
        float rect[4];
        float round;
        float intensity;
        float softness;
        float pad0;
        float color[4];
    };

    struct GlowRequest
    {
        ImRect  rect;
        float   round;
        float   strength;
        ImVec4  color;
    };

    static const char* k_vs_hlsl = R"(
        cbuffer CB : register(b0)
        {
            float4 rect;
            float2 display;
            float2 pad;
        };
        struct VSIn { float2 pos : POSITION; };
        struct VSOut { float4 pos : SV_POSITION; float2 pixel : TEXCOORD0; };
        VSOut main(VSIn input)
        {
            float2 p = lerp(rect.xy, rect.zw, input.pos);
            float2 ndc;
            ndc.x = (p.x / display.x) * 2.0 - 1.0;
            ndc.y = 1.0 - (p.y / display.y) * 2.0;
            VSOut o;
            o.pos = float4(ndc, 0.0, 1.0);
            o.pixel = p;
            return o;
        }
    )";

    static const char* k_ps_hlsl = R"(
        cbuffer CB : register(b0)
        {
            float4 rect;
            float round;
            float intensity;
            float softness;
            float pad0;
            float4 color;
        };
        struct PSIn { float4 pos : SV_POSITION; float2 pixel : TEXCOORD0; };
        float rounded_box_sd(float2 p, float2 half_size, float round)
        {
            float2 q = abs(p) - half_size + round;
            return length(max(q, 0.0)) + min(max(q.x, q.y), 0.0) - round;
        }
        float4 main(PSIn input) : SV_TARGET
        {
            float2 center = (rect.xy + rect.zw) * 0.5;
            float2 half_size = (rect.zw - rect.xy) * 0.5;
            float2 p = input.pixel - center;
            float dist = rounded_box_sd(p, half_size, round);
            float edge = max(softness, 0.001);
            float glow = exp(-(dist * dist) / (edge * edge));
            float alpha = saturate(glow * intensity) * color.a;
            return float4(color.rgb * alpha, alpha);
        }
    )";

    ID3D11Device*           s_device           = nullptr;
    ID3D11VertexShader*     s_vs               = nullptr;
    ID3D11PixelShader*      s_ps               = nullptr;
    ID3D11InputLayout*      s_layout           = nullptr;
    ID3D11Buffer*           s_vs_cb            = nullptr;
    ID3D11Buffer*           s_ps_cb            = nullptr;
    ID3D11Buffer*           s_vb               = nullptr;
    ID3D11BlendState*       s_blend            = nullptr;
    ID3D11RasterizerState*  s_raster           = nullptr;
    ID3D11DepthStencilState* s_depth           = nullptr;
    std::vector<GlowRequest> s_queue;

    bool compile_shader(const char* src, const char* entry, const char* target, ID3DBlob** blob)
    {
        ID3DBlob* error = nullptr;
        const HRESULT hr = D3DCompile(src, strlen(src), nullptr, nullptr, nullptr,
            entry, target, D3DCOMPILE_OPTIMIZATION_LEVEL3, 0, blob, &error);
        if (FAILED(hr))
        {
            if (error) error->Release();
            return false;
        }
        if (error) error->Release();
        return true;
    }

    bool create_states()
    {
        D3D11_BLEND_DESC blend = {};
        blend.RenderTarget[0].BlendEnable           = TRUE;
        blend.RenderTarget[0].SrcBlend              = D3D11_BLEND_ONE;
        blend.RenderTarget[0].DestBlend             = D3D11_BLEND_ONE;
        blend.RenderTarget[0].BlendOp               = D3D11_BLEND_OP_ADD;
        blend.RenderTarget[0].SrcBlendAlpha         = D3D11_BLEND_ONE;
        blend.RenderTarget[0].DestBlendAlpha        = D3D11_BLEND_ONE;
        blend.RenderTarget[0].BlendOpAlpha          = D3D11_BLEND_OP_ADD;
        blend.RenderTarget[0].RenderTargetWriteMask = D3D11_COLOR_WRITE_ENABLE_ALL;
        if (FAILED(s_device->CreateBlendState(&blend, &s_blend)))
            return false;

        D3D11_RASTERIZER_DESC raster = {};
        raster.FillMode = D3D11_FILL_SOLID;
        raster.CullMode = D3D11_CULL_NONE;
        raster.ScissorEnable = FALSE;
        raster.DepthClipEnable = TRUE;
        if (FAILED(s_device->CreateRasterizerState(&raster, &s_raster)))
            return false;

        D3D11_DEPTH_STENCIL_DESC depth = {};
        depth.DepthEnable = FALSE;
        depth.DepthWriteMask = D3D11_DEPTH_WRITE_MASK_ALL;
        depth.DepthFunc = D3D11_COMPARISON_ALWAYS;
        depth.StencilEnable = FALSE;
        if (FAILED(s_device->CreateDepthStencilState(&depth, &s_depth)))
            return false;

        D3D11_BUFFER_DESC vb = {};
        vb.Usage = D3D11_USAGE_DYNAMIC;
        vb.ByteWidth = sizeof(float) * 8;
        vb.BindFlags = D3D11_BIND_VERTEX_BUFFER;
        vb.CPUAccessFlags = D3D11_CPU_ACCESS_WRITE;
        return SUCCEEDED(s_device->CreateBuffer(&vb, nullptr, &s_vb));
    }
}

namespace glow_renderer
{
    bool init(ID3D11Device* device)
    {
        shutdown();
        if (!device)
            return false;

        s_device = device;
        s_device->AddRef();

        ID3DBlob* vs_blob = nullptr;
        ID3DBlob* ps_blob = nullptr;
        if (!compile_shader(k_vs_hlsl, "main", "vs_4_0", &vs_blob))
            return false;
        if (!compile_shader(k_ps_hlsl, "main", "ps_4_0", &ps_blob))
        {
            vs_blob->Release();
            return false;
        }

        if (FAILED(s_device->CreateVertexShader(vs_blob->GetBufferPointer(), vs_blob->GetBufferSize(), nullptr, &s_vs)))
        {
            vs_blob->Release();
            ps_blob->Release();
            return false;
        }

        const D3D11_INPUT_ELEMENT_DESC layout[] = {
            { "POSITION", 0, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32_FLOAT, 0, 0, D3D11_INPUT_PER_VERTEX_DATA, 0 },
        };
        if (FAILED(s_device->CreateInputLayout(layout, 1, vs_blob->GetBufferPointer(), vs_blob->GetBufferSize(), &s_layout)))
        {
            vs_blob->Release();
            ps_blob->Release();
            return false;
        }
        vs_blob->Release();

        if (FAILED(s_device->CreatePixelShader(ps_blob->GetBufferPointer(), ps_blob->GetBufferSize(), nullptr, &s_ps)))
        {
            ps_blob->Release();
            return false;
        }
        ps_blob->Release();

        D3D11_BUFFER_DESC cb = {};
        cb.Usage = D3D11_USAGE_DYNAMIC;
        cb.BindFlags = D3D11_BIND_CONSTANT_BUFFER;
        cb.CPUAccessFlags = D3D11_CPU_ACCESS_WRITE;
        cb.ByteWidth = sizeof(float) * 4;
        if (FAILED(s_device->CreateBuffer(&cb, nullptr, &s_vs_cb)))
            return false;

        cb.ByteWidth = (sizeof(GlowCB) + 15) & ~15;
        if (FAILED(s_device->CreateBuffer(&cb, nullptr, &s_ps_cb)))
            return false;

        if (!create_states())
            return false;

        return true;
    }

    void shutdown()
    {
        s_queue.clear();
        if (s_vb)     { s_vb->Release();     s_vb = nullptr; }
        if (s_vs_cb)  { s_vs_cb->Release();  s_vs_cb = nullptr; }
        if (s_ps_cb)  { s_ps_cb->Release();  s_ps_cb = nullptr; }
        if (s_blend)  { s_blend->Release();  s_blend = nullptr; }
        if (s_raster) { s_raster->Release(); s_raster = nullptr; }
        if (s_depth)  { s_depth->Release();  s_depth = nullptr; }
        if (s_layout) { s_layout->Release(); s_layout = nullptr; }
        if (s_ps)     { s_ps->Release();     s_ps = nullptr; }
        if (s_vs)     { s_vs->Release();     s_vs = nullptr; }
        if (s_device) { s_device->Release(); s_device = nullptr; }
    }

    void queue_rect(const ImRect& rect, float round, float strength, const ImVec4& color)
    {
        if (strength < 0.01f)
            return;
        s_queue.push_back({ rect, round, strength, color });
    }

    void clear_queue()
    {
        s_queue.clear();
    }

    void flush(ID3D11DeviceContext* ctx, const ImVec2& display_size)
    {
        if (!ctx || !s_vs || !s_ps || s_queue.empty() || display_size.x <= 0.f || display_size.y <= 0.f)
            return;

        D3D11_VIEWPORT vp = {};
        vp.Width    = display_size.x;
        vp.Height   = display_size.y;
        vp.MaxDepth = 1.f;
        ctx->RSSetViewports(1, &vp);
        ctx->IASetInputLayout(s_layout);
        ctx->IASetPrimitiveTopology(D3D11_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLESTRIP);
        ctx->VSSetShader(s_vs, nullptr, 0);
        ctx->PSSetShader(s_ps, nullptr, 0);
        ctx->RSSetState(s_raster);
        ctx->OMSetDepthStencilState(s_depth, 0);

        const float blend_factor[4] = { 0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.f };
        ctx->OMSetBlendState(s_blend, blend_factor, 0xFFFFFFFF);

        const UINT stride = sizeof(float) * 2;
        const UINT offset = 0;

        for (const GlowRequest& req : s_queue)
        {
            const float expand = 18.f + req.strength * 12.f;
            const ImRect draw_bb(
                { req.rect.Min.x - expand, req.rect.Min.y - expand },
                { req.rect.Max.x + expand, req.rect.Max.y + expand });

            struct VSCB { float rect[4]; float display[2]; float pad[2]; } vs_data = {};
            vs_data.rect[0] = draw_bb.Min.x;
            vs_data.rect[1] = draw_bb.Min.y;
            vs_data.rect[2] = draw_bb.Max.x;
            vs_data.rect[3] = draw_bb.Max.y;
            vs_data.display[0] = display_size.x;
            vs_data.display[1] = display_size.y;

            D3D11_MAPPED_SUBRESOURCE mapped = {};
            if (SUCCEEDED(ctx->Map(s_vs_cb, 0, D3D11_MAP_WRITE_DISCARD, 0, &mapped)))
            {
                memcpy(mapped.pData, &vs_data, sizeof(vs_data));
                ctx->Unmap(s_vs_cb, 0);
            }

            GlowCB ps_data = {};
            ps_data.rect[0] = req.rect.Min.x;
            ps_data.rect[1] = req.rect.Min.y;
            ps_data.rect[2] = req.rect.Max.x;
            ps_data.rect[3] = req.rect.Max.y;
            ps_data.round     = req.round;
            ps_data.intensity = req.strength * 0.62f;
            ps_data.softness  = 9.f + req.round * 0.45f;
            ps_data.color[0]  = req.color.x;
            ps_data.color[1]  = req.color.y;
            ps_data.color[2]  = req.color.z;
            ps_data.color[3]  = 1.f;

            if (SUCCEEDED(ctx->Map(s_ps_cb, 0, D3D11_MAP_WRITE_DISCARD, 0, &mapped)))
            {
                memcpy(mapped.pData, &ps_data, sizeof(ps_data));
                ctx->Unmap(s_ps_cb, 0);
            }

            const float verts[8] = { 0.f, 0.f, 1.f, 0.f, 0.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f };
            if (SUCCEEDED(ctx->Map(s_vb, 0, D3D11_MAP_WRITE_DISCARD, 0, &mapped)))
            {
                memcpy(mapped.pData, verts, sizeof(verts));
                ctx->Unmap(s_vb, 0);
            }

            ctx->IASetVertexBuffers(0, 1, &s_vb, &stride, &offset);
            ctx->VSSetConstantBuffers(0, 1, &s_vs_cb);
            ctx->PSSetConstantBuffers(0, 1, &s_ps_cb);
            ctx->Draw(4, 0);
        }
    }
}

#include "window.h"
#include "../app/gui.h"

#include <float.h>

#include "imgui.h"
#include "imgui_impl_win32.h"

extern IMGUI_IMPL_API LRESULT ImGui_ImplWin32_WndProcHandler(HWND hWnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam);

LRESULT WINAPI app_wnd_proc(HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wparam, LPARAM lparam)
{
    auto* surface = reinterpret_cast<AppSurface*>(::GetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWLP_USERDATA));

    if (msg == WM_NCHITTEST)
    {
        if (!gui::g_menu_open)
            return HTTRANSPARENT;

        POINT pt = { (short)LOWORD(lparam), (short)HIWORD(lparam) };
        ::ScreenToClient(hwnd, &pt);
        if (!gui::is_point_inside((float)pt.x, (float)pt.y))
            return HTTRANSPARENT;
        return HTCLIENT;
    }

    if (surface && surface->imgui_win32_route)
    {
        if (ImGui_ImplWin32_WndProcHandler(hwnd, msg, wparam, lparam))
            return true;
    }

    switch (msg)
    {
    case WM_KEYDOWN:
        if (wparam == VK_ESCAPE)
            ::PostQuitMessage(0);
        return 0;
    case WM_SIZE:
        if (surface && wparam != SIZE_MINIMIZED)
        {
            surface->pending_w = (unsigned)LOWORD(lparam);
            surface->pending_h = (unsigned)HIWORD(lparam);
        }
        return 0;
    case WM_DESTROY:
        if (surface && surface->quit_app_on_destroy)
            ::PostQuitMessage(0);
        return 0;
    }
    return ::DefWindowProcW(hwnd, msg, wparam, lparam);
}

bool app_surface_consume_resize(AppSurface& surface, unsigned& width, unsigned& height)
{
    if (surface.pending_w == 0 || surface.pending_h == 0) return false;
    width  = surface.pending_w;
    height = surface.pending_h;
    surface.pending_w = surface.pending_h = 0;
    return true;
}

void app_update_io_for_hwnd(HWND hwnd, ImGuiIO& io)
{
    RECT client = {};
    ::GetClientRect(hwnd, &client);
    io.DisplaySize = ImVec2(
        (float)max(client.right  - client.left, 1),
        (float)max(client.bottom - client.top,  1));

    POINT cursor = {};
    ::GetCursorPos(&cursor);

    HWND hovered = ::WindowFromPoint(cursor);
    const bool over = (hovered == hwnd || ::IsChild(hwnd, hovered));

    if (over)
    {
        POINT local = cursor;
        ::ScreenToClient(hwnd, &local);
        io.AddMousePosEvent((float)local.x, (float)local.y);
    }
    else
    {
        io.AddMousePosEvent(-FLT_MAX, -FLT_MAX);
    }

    io.AddMouseButtonEvent(0, (GetAsyncKeyState(VK_LBUTTON) & 0x8000) != 0);
    io.AddMouseButtonEvent(1, (GetAsyncKeyState(VK_RBUTTON) & 0x8000) != 0);
    io.AddMouseButtonEvent(2, (GetAsyncKeyState(VK_MBUTTON) & 0x8000) != 0);
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\91xb6k7\framework\esp\emu_connect.hpp ===== 
#pragma once
// In-process emulator connection (port of Grej Labs' MainThread).
// Must run inside the BlueStacks process: hooks BstkVMM!PGMPhysRead to capture the VM pointer.

#include <Windows.h>
#include <string>
#include <atomic>
#include <MinHook.h>

#include <Cheat/Options.hpp>
#include <Cheat/Offsets/Offsets.hpp>
#include <FrameWork/Utilities/Memory/Memory.hpp>
#include <FrameWork/Utilities/Adb/adb_utils.hpp>

namespace emu_connect {

    inline std::atomic<const char*> status{ "Idle" };

    inline DWORD WINAPI thread_main( LPVOID )
    {
        using FrameWork::MemoryUtils;

        status = "Initializing...";
        Sleep( 1000 );

        HMODULE vmm = GetModuleHandleA( "BstkVMM.dll" );
        if ( !vmm ) { status = "BstkVMM.dll not found (inject into HD-Player)"; return 0; }

        auto read_fn = ( MemoryUtils::PGMPhysReadFunc )GetProcAddress( vmm, "PGMPhysRead" );
        if ( !read_fn ) { status = "PGMPhysRead not found"; return 0; }

        const MH_STATUS init = MH_Initialize( );
        if ( init != MH_OK && init != MH_ERROR_ALREADY_INITIALIZED ) { status = "MinHook init failed"; return 0; }

        if ( MH_CreateHook( ( LPVOID )read_fn, ( LPVOID )MemoryUtils::HookedPGMPhysRead, ( LPVOID* )&MemoryUtils::ogPhysRead ) != MH_OK )
        { status = "Hook creation failed"; return 0; }
        if ( MH_EnableHook( ( LPVOID )read_fn ) != MH_OK ) { status = "Hook enable failed"; return 0; }

        status = "Waiting for VM pointer...";
        for ( int waited = 0; MemoryUtils::vmPtr == nullptr; ++waited )
        {
            Sleep( 10 );
            if ( waited > 1500 ) { status = "VM pointer timeout"; return 0; }
        }

        MemoryUtils::ogCPU   = ( MemoryUtils::VMMGetCpuByIdFunc )GetProcAddress( vmm, "VMMGetCpuById" );
        MemoryUtils::ogCast  = ( MemoryUtils::PGMPhysGCPtr2GCPhysFunc )GetProcAddress( vmm, "PGMPhysGCPtr2GCPhys" );
        MemoryUtils::ogWrite = ( MemoryUtils::PGMPhysSimpleWriteGCPhysFunc )GetProcAddress( vmm, "PGMPhysSimpleWriteGCPhys" );
        if ( !MemoryUtils::ogCPU || !MemoryUtils::ogCast || !MemoryUtils::ogWrite ) { status = "VMM functions missing"; return 0; }

        MemoryUtils::Initialize( MemoryUtils::vmPtr );

        if ( !CambiarDirectoryZ( GetExeDirectoryZ( ) ) ) { status = "Emulator directory error"; return 0; }

        KillProcessByName( "HD-Adb.exe" );
        KillProcessByName( "HD-Adb.exe" );
        KillProcessByName( "HD-Adb.exe" );
        ComdADBZ( "kill-server" );
        ComdADBZ( "devices" );

        status = "Scanning game libraries...";
        Sleep( 400 );

        std::string il2cpp;
        for ( int tries = 0; ; ++tries )
        {
            il2cpp = ShellGetAddressNoSuZ( "cat /proc/*/maps | grep libil2cpp.so" );
            if ( !il2cpp.empty( ) ) break;
            if ( tries > 10 ) { status = "libil2cpp.so not found - start the game, then re-inject"; return 0; }
            status = "Waiting for game (libil2cpp.so)...";
            Sleep( 1500 );
        }

        Offsets::Il2Cpp = uIntExtrZ( il2cpp );
        if ( Offsets::Il2Cpp == 0 ) { status = "Fetching libil2cpp failed"; return 0; }

        g_Options.Hook.IsInjected = true;
        Context::IsReady = true;   // ← ESP draw gate open ho jata hai
        status = "Connection established";
        return 0;
    }

    inline void start( )
    {
        CreateThread( nullptr, 0, thread_main, nullptr, 0, nullptr );
    }

} // namespace emu_connect
 
 
===== FILE: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\91xb6k7\framework\esp\esp_overlay.hpp ===== 
#pragma once
// Transparent click-through ESP overlay drawn over the emulator render window.
// Runs on the UI thread with its own ImGui context (shares the Silk D3D11 device).
// Also runs Data::Work() on this thread so the entity map is never read while being rebuilt.

#include <Windows.h>
#include <d3d11.h>
#include <dxgi.h>
#include <dwmapi.h>
#include <wrl/client.h>
#include <imgui.h>
#include <imgui_impl_dx11.h>
#include <imgui_impl_win32.h>

#include <Cheat/Options.hpp>
#include <Cheat/Data/Data.hpp>
#include <Cheat/FreeFireSDK/Context.hpp>
#include <Cheat/Features/Visuals/PlayerEsp.hpp>
#include <FrameWork/Utilities/FindRender/Render.hpp>
#include <FrameWork/Render/Assets.hpp>

namespace esp_overlay {

    using Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr;

    inline HWND                         g_window  = nullptr;
    inline HWND                         g_target  = nullptr;
    inline ImGuiContext*                g_ctx     = nullptr;
    inline ComPtr<IDXGISwapChain>       g_swap;
    inline ComPtr<ID3D11RenderTargetView> g_rtv;
    inline int                          g_w = 0, g_h = 0;
    inline ULONGLONG                    g_last_find = 0;
    inline bool                         g_affinity_on = false;
    inline const wchar_t*               g_class = L"SilkEspOverlay";

    inline LRESULT CALLBACK wnd_proc( HWND h, UINT m, WPARAM w, LPARAM l ) { return ::DefWindowProcW( h, m, w, l ); }

    inline bool target_rect( RECT& r )
    {
        if ( !g_target || !::IsWindow( g_target ) ) return false;
        if ( !::GetClientRect( g_target, &r ) ) return false;
        ::MapWindowPoints( g_target, nullptr, reinterpret_cast< LPPOINT >( &r ), 2 );
        return ( r.right - r.left ) > 0 && ( r.bottom - r.top ) > 0;
    }

    inline void make_rtv( )
    {
        ComPtr<ID3D11Texture2D> back;
        if ( SUCCEEDED( g_swap->GetBuffer( 0, IID_PPV_ARGS( &back ) ) ) )
        {
            ID3D11Device* dev = nullptr;
            g_swap->GetDevice( IID_PPV_ARGS( &dev ) );
            if ( dev ) { dev->CreateRenderTargetView( back.Get( ), nullptr, &g_rtv ); dev->Release( ); }
        }
    }

    inline bool create( HINSTANCE inst, ID3D11Device* device, ID3D11DeviceContext* dctx, const RECT& r )
    {
        WNDCLASSEXW wc{ sizeof( wc ) };
        wc.lpfnWndProc = wnd_proc;
        wc.hInstance = inst;
        wc.lpszClassName = g_class;
        wc.hCursor = ::LoadCursor( nullptr, IDC_ARROW );
        ::RegisterClassExW( &wc );

        g_w = r.right - r.left;
        g_h = r.bottom - r.top;
        g_window = ::CreateWindowExW(
            WS_EX_TOPMOST | WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW | WS_EX_LAYERED | WS_EX_TRANSPARENT | WS_EX_NOACTIVATE,
            g_class, L"", WS_POPUP | WS_VISIBLE, r.left, r.top, g_w, g_h, nullptr, nullptr, inst, nullptr );
        if ( !g_window ) return false;

        const MARGINS m{ -1, -1, -1, -1 };
        ::DwmExtendFrameIntoClientArea( g_window, &m );
        ::SetLayeredWindowAttributes( g_window, RGB( 0, 0, 0 ), 255, LWA_ALPHA );

        ComPtr<IDXGIDevice> dxgi_dev;
        ComPtr<IDXGIAdapter> adapter;
        ComPtr<IDXGIFactory> factory;
        if ( FAILED( device->QueryInterface( IID_PPV_ARGS( &dxgi_dev ) ) ) ||
             FAILED( dxgi_dev->GetAdapter( &adapter ) ) ||
             FAILED( adapter->GetParent( IID_PPV_ARGS( &factory ) ) ) )
            return false;

        DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_DESC sd{};
        sd.BufferDesc.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
        sd.SampleDesc.Count = 1;
        sd.BufferUsage = DXGI_USAGE_RENDER_TARGET_OUTPUT;
        sd.BufferCount = 2;
        sd.OutputWindow = g_window;
        sd.Windowed = TRUE;
        sd.SwapEffect = DXGI_SWAP_EFFECT_DISCARD;
        if ( FAILED( factory->CreateSwapChain( device, &sd, &g_swap ) ) ) return false;
        make_rtv( );

        ImGuiContext* previous = ImGui::GetCurrentContext( );
        g_ctx = ImGui::CreateContext( );
        ImGui::SetCurrentContext( g_ctx );
        ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO( );
        io.IniFilename = nullptr;
        io.LogFilename = nullptr;

        ImFont* bold = io.Fonts->AddFontFromFileTTF( "C:\\Windows\\Fonts\\segoeuib.ttf", 15.f );
        ImFont* semi = io.Fonts->AddFontFromFileTTF( "C:\\Windows\\Fonts\\seguisb.ttf", 14.f );
        if ( !bold ) bold = io.Fonts->AddFontDefault( );
        if ( !semi ) semi = bold;
        Assets::InterExtraBold = bold;
        Assets::InterSemiBold = semi;
        Assets::icomoon = bold;
        Assets::lexend_bold = bold;
        Assets::lexend_regular = semi;

        const bool ok = ImGui_ImplWin32_Init( g_window ) && ImGui_ImplDX11_Init( device, dctx );
        ImGui::SetCurrentContext( previous );
        return ok;
    }

    inline void resize( const RECT& r )
    {
        const int w = r.right - r.left, h = r.bottom - r.top;
        ::MoveWindow( g_window, r.left, r.top, w, h, FALSE );
        if ( w != g_w || h != g_h )
        {
            g_rtv.Reset( );
            g_swap->ResizeBuffers( 0, w, h, DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN, 0 );
            make_rtv( );
            g_w = w; g_h = h;
        }
    }

    // Call once per loop iteration, before the Silk UI frame.
    inline void frame( HINSTANCE inst, ID3D11Device* device, ID3D11DeviceContext* dctx )
    {
        // Don't touch memory or render until emu_connect finishes hooking BstkVMM & ADB
        if ( !Context::IsReady )
            return;

        // Locate the emulator render window (retry once per second).
        if ( ( !g_target || !::IsWindow( g_target ) ) && ::GetTickCount64( ) - g_last_find > 1000 )
        {
            g_last_find = ::GetTickCount64( );
            g_target = FrameWork::FindeRender::FindRenderWindow( );
        }

        RECT r{};
        const bool have_target = target_rect( r );
        if ( have_target )
        {
            Context::WindowWidth  = r.right - r.left;
            Context::WindowHeight = r.bottom - r.top;
        }
        else
        {
            if ( Context::WindowWidth  <= 0 ) Context::WindowWidth  = ::GetSystemMetrics( SM_CXSCREEN );
            if ( Context::WindowHeight <= 0 ) Context::WindowHeight = ::GetSystemMetrics( SM_CYSCREEN );
        }

        try {
            FrameWork::Data::Work( );
        } catch ( ... ) {}

        if ( !have_target ) { if ( g_window ) ::ShowWindow( g_window, SW_HIDE ); return; }

        if ( !g_window )
        {
            if ( !create( inst, device, dctx, r ) ) return;
        }
        else
        {
            if ( !::IsWindowVisible( g_window ) ) ::ShowWindow( g_window, SW_SHOWNOACTIVATE );
            resize( r );
        }

        if ( g_Options.Visuals.HideFromCapture != g_affinity_on )
        {
            g_affinity_on = g_Options.Visuals.HideFromCapture;
            ::SetWindowDisplayAffinity( g_window, g_affinity_on ? WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE : WDA_NONE );
        }

        ImGuiContext* previous = ImGui::GetCurrentContext( );
        ImGui::SetCurrentContext( g_ctx );

        ImGui_ImplDX11_NewFrame( );
        ImGui_ImplWin32_NewFrame( );
        ImGui::NewFrame( );
        {
            if ( g_Options.Misc.Screen.ShowAimbotFov )
            {
                const auto& c = g_Options.Misc.Screen.AimbotFovColor;
                ImGui::GetBackgroundDrawList( )->AddCircle(
                    ImVec2( ImGui::GetIO( ).DisplaySize.x / 2, ImGui::GetIO( ).DisplaySize.y / 2 ),
                    static_cast< float >( g_Options.LegitBot.AimBot.FOVRange ), ImColor( c[ 0 ], c[ 1 ], c[ 2 ], c[ 3 ] ), 360 );
            }
            if ( g_Options.Visuals.ESP.Players.Enabled )
            {
                try {
                    Cheat::ESP::Players( );
                } catch ( ... ) {}
            }
        }
        ImGui::EndFrame( );
        ImGui::Render( );

        const float clear[ 4 ] = { 0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.f };
        ID3D11RenderTargetView* rtv = g_rtv.Get( );
        if ( !rtv )
        {
            ImGui::SetCurrentContext( previous );
            return;
        }
        dctx->OMSetRenderTargets( 1, &rtv, nullptr );
        dctx->ClearRenderTargetView( rtv, clear );
        ImGui_ImplDX11_RenderDrawData( ImGui::GetDrawData( ) );
        g_swap->Present( 0, 0 );

        ImGui::SetCurrentContext( previous );
    }

} // namespace esp_overlay

namespace {
    void ApplyTimerSpeed(uint32_t currentGame, float value)
    {
        if (currentGame == 0) return;
        uint32_t timerObj = 0;
        if (!FrameWork::Mem.Read<uint32_t>(currentGame + Offsets::GameTimer, timerObj) || timerObj == 0) return;
        FrameWork::Mem.Write<float>(timerObj + Offsets::FixedDeltaTime, value);
    }

    namespace DownPlayerState {
        std::unordered_map<uint32_t, float> originalY;
        bool isFiring = false;
        bool forceRefresh = true;

        void RefreshOriginalY()
        {
            if (!isFiring) {
                originalY.clear();
                forceRefresh = true;
            }
        }

        bool ResolveRootMatrix(uint32_t entityAddress, uint32_t& matrixPtr)
        {
            uint32_t rootBone = 0;
            uint32_t transform = 0;
            matrixPtr = 0;

            if (!Mem.Read(entityAddress + Offsets::Bones::Root, rootBone) || rootBone == 0)
                return false;
            if (!Mem.Read(rootBone + 0x8, transform) || transform == 0)
                return false;
            if (!Mem.Read(transform + 0x8, transform) || transform == 0)
                return false;
            if (!Mem.Read(transform + 0x20, matrixPtr) || matrixPtr == 0)
                return false;

            return true;
        }

        Entity* FindBestTarget()
        {
            if (Context::Entities.empty())
                return nullptr;

            Entity* best = nullptr;
            float bestDistance = FLT_MAX;
            const Vector2 center(Context::WindowWidth * 0.5f, Context::WindowHeight * 0.5f);

            for (auto& [id, entity] : Context::Entities) {
                if (entity.Address == 0 || entity.Address == Context::LocalPlayerAddress ||
                    !entity.IsKnown || entity.IsDead || entity.IsKnocked)
                    continue;

                const Vector2 head2D = W2S::WorldToScreen(
                    Context::ViewMatrix, entity.Head, Context::WindowWidth, Context::WindowHeight);
                if (head2D.X < 1.0f || head2D.Y < 1.0f)
                    continue;

                if (Vector3::Distance(Context::LocalMainCamera, entity.Head) > 200.0f)
                    continue;

                const float screenDistance = Vector2::Distance(center, head2D);
                if (screenDistance > 500.0f || screenDistance >= bestDistance)
                    continue;

                bestDistance = screenDistance;
                best = &entity;
            }

            return best;
        }

        void AimAtTarget(Entity* target)
        {
            if (!target)
                return;

            uint32_t matrixPtr = 0;
            if (!ResolveRootMatrix(target->Address, matrixPtr))
                return;

            Vector3 enemyPosition;
            if (!Mem.Read(matrixPtr + 0x60, enemyPosition))
                return;

            const auto key = target->Address;
            if (forceRefresh || originalY.find(key) == originalY.end())
                originalY[key] = enemyPosition.Y;

            const float desiredY = originalY[key] +
                g_Options.Misc.Exploits.LocalPlayer.DownValue;
            if (std::abs(enemyPosition.Y - desiredY) > 0.2f) {
                enemyPosition.Y = desiredY;
                Mem.Write(matrixPtr + 0x60, enemyPosition);
            }
        }
    }

                        constexpr float rapidValue = 0.1f;  // Changed from 0.5f to 0.1f

                    g_Options.Misc.Exploits.LocalPlayer.LastRapidFireState = false;

            Context::LocalMainCamera = mainPos;

            uint32_t followCamera = Mem.ReadS<uint32_t>(localPlayer + Offsets::FollowCamera);
