{
    return (b - a) * t + a;
}

float Vector3::Magnitude(Vector3 v)
{
    return sqrt(SqrMagnitude(v));
}

Vector3 Vector3::Max(Vector3 a, Vector3 b)
{
    float x = a.X > b.X ? a.X : b.X;
    float y = a.Y > b.Y ? a.Y : b.Y;
    float z = a.Z > b.Z ? a.Z : b.Z;
    return Vector3(x, y, z);
}

Vector3 Vector3::Min(Vector3 a, Vector3 b)
{
    float x = a.X > b.X ? b.X : a.X;
    float y = a.Y > b.Y ? b.Y : a.Y;
    float z = a.Z > b.Z ? b.Z : a.Z;
    return Vector3(x, y, z);
}

Vector3 Vector3::MoveTowards(Vector3 current, Vector3 target,
    float maxDistanceDelta)
{
    Vector3 d = target - current;
    float m = Magnitude(d);
    if (m < maxDistanceDelta || m == 0)
        return target;
    return current + (d * maxDistanceDelta / m);
}

Vector3 Vector3::Normalize(const Vector3& v) {
    float mag = Magnitude(v);
    if (mag == 0) return Vector3(0, 0, 0);
    return Vector3(v.X / mag, v.Y / mag, v.Z / mag);
}

Vector3 Vector3::Orthogonal(Vector3 v)
{
    return v.Z < v.X ? Vector3(v.Y, -v.X, 0) : Vector3(0, -v.Z, v.Y);
}

void Vector3::OrthoNormalize(Vector3& normal, Vector3& tangent,
    Vector3& binormal)
{
    normal = Normalize(normal);
    tangent = ProjectOnPlane(tangent, normal);
    tangent = Normalize(tangent);
    binormal = ProjectOnPlane(binormal, tangent);
    binormal = ProjectOnPlane(binormal, normal);
    binormal = Normalize(binormal);
}

Vector3 Vector3::Project(Vector3 a, Vector3 b)
{
    float m = Magnitude(b);
    return Dot(a, b) / (m * m) * b;
}

Vector3 Vector3::ProjectOnPlane(Vector3 vector, Vector3 planeNormal)
{
    return Reject(vector, planeNormal);
}

Vector3 Vector3::Reflect(Vector3 vector, Vector3 planeNormal)
{
    return vector - 2 * Project(vector, planeNormal);
}

Vector3 Vector3::Reject(Vector3 a, Vector3 b)
{
    return a - Project(a, b);
}

Vector3 Vector3::RotateTowards(Vector3 current, Vector3 target,
    float maxRadiansDelta,
    float maxMagnitudeDelta)
{
    float magCur = Magnitude(current);
    float magTar = Magnitude(target);
    float newMag = magCur + maxMagnitudeDelta *
        ((magTar > magCur) - (magCur > magTar));
    newMag = fmin(newMag, fmax(magCur, magTar));
    newMag = fmax(newMag, fmin(magCur, magTar));

    float totalAngle = Angle(current, target) - maxRadiansDelta;
    if (totalAngle <= 0)
        return Normalize(target) * newMag;
    else if (totalAngle >= M_PI)
        return Normalize(-target) * newMag;

    Vector3 axis = Cross(current, target);
    float magAxis = Magnitude(axis);
    if (magAxis == 0)
        axis = Normalize(Cross(current, current + Vector3(3.95, 5.32, -4.24)));
    else
        axis /= magAxis;
    current = Normalize(current);
    Vector3 newVector = current * cos(maxRadiansDelta) +
        Cross(axis, current) * sin(maxRadiansDelta);
    return newVector * newMag;
}

Vector3 Vector3::Scale(Vector3 a, Vector3 b)
{
    return Vector3(a.X * b.X, a.Y * b.Y, a.Z * b.Z);
}

Vector3 Vector3::Slerp(Vector3 a, Vector3 b, float t)
{
    if (t < 0) return a;
    else if (t > 1) return b;
    return SlerpUnclamped(a, b, t);
}

Vector3 Vector3::SlerpUnclamped(Vector3 a, Vector3 b, float t)
{
    float magA = Magnitude(a);
    float magB = Magnitude(b);
    a /= magA;
    b /= magB;
    float dot = Dot(a, b);
    dot = fmax(dot, -1.0);
    dot = fmin(dot, 1.0);
    float theta = acos(dot) * t;
    Vector3 relativeVec = Normalize(b - a * dot);
    Vector3 newVec = a * cos(theta) + relativeVec * sin(theta);
    return newVec * (magA + (magB - magA) * t);
}

float Vector3::SqrMagnitude(Vector3 v)
{
    return v.X * v.X + v.Y * v.Y + v.Z * v.Z;
}

void Vector3::ToSpherical(Vector3 vector, float& rad, float& theta,
    float& phi)
{
    rad = Magnitude(vector);
    float v = vector.Z / rad;
    v = fmax(v, -1.0);
    v = fmin(v, 1.0);
    theta = acos(v);
    phi = atan2(vector.Y, vector.X);
}


struct Vector3& Vector3::operator+=(const float rhs)
{
    X += rhs;
    Y += rhs;
    Z += rhs;
    return *this;
}

struct Vector3& Vector3::operator-=(const float rhs)
{
    X -= rhs;
    Y -= rhs;
    Z -= rhs;
    return *this;
}

struct Vector3& Vector3::operator*=(const float rhs)
{
    X *= rhs;
    Y *= rhs;
    Z *= rhs;
    return *this;
}

struct Vector3& Vector3::operator/=(const float rhs)
{
    X /= rhs;
    Y /= rhs;
    Z /= rhs;
    return *this;
}

struct Vector3& Vector3::operator+=(const Vector3 rhs)
{
    X += rhs.X;
    Y += rhs.Y;
    Z += rhs.Z;
    return *this;
}

struct Vector3& Vector3::operator-=(const Vector3 rhs)
{
    X -= rhs.X;
    Y -= rhs.Y;
    Z -= rhs.Z;
    return *this;
}

Vector3 operator-(Vector3 rhs) { return rhs * -1; }
Vector3 operator+(Vector3 lhs, const float rhs) { return lhs += rhs; }
Vector3 operator-(Vector3 lhs, const float rhs) { return lhs -= rhs; }
Vector3 operator*(Vector3 lhs, const float rhs) { return lhs *= rhs; }
Vector3 operator/(Vector3 lhs, const float rhs) { return lhs /= rhs; }
Vector3 operator+(const float lhs, Vector3 rhs) { return rhs += lhs; }
Vector3 operator-(const float lhs, Vector3 rhs) { return rhs -= lhs; }
Vector3 operator*(const float lhs, Vector3 rhs) { return rhs *= lhs; }
Vector3 operator/(const float lhs, Vector3 rhs) { return rhs /= lhs; }

Vector3 operator-(Vector3 lhs, const Vector3 rhs) { return lhs -= rhs; }

bool operator==(const Vector3 lhs, const Vector3 rhs)
{
    return lhs.X == rhs.X && lhs.Y == rhs.Y && lhs.Z == rhs.Z;
}

bool operator!=(const Vector3 lhs, const Vector3 rhs)
{
    return !(lhs == rhs);
}

static bool juegoAbierto = false;

typedef unsigned char bimno1;

struct PatternData {
    std::vector<bimno1> pattern;
    std::vector<bimno1> mask;
};

std::vector<bimno1> StringToBytes1(const std::string& pattern) {
    std::vector<bimno1> bytes;
    std::istringstream stream(pattern);
    std::string byteStr;

    while (stream >> byteStr) {
        bytes.push_back(static_cast<bimno1>(std::stoul(byteStr, nullptr, 16)));
    }
    return bytes;
}

class Adb {
private:
    std::wstring path;
    PROCESS_INFORMATION processInfo;

public:
    Adb(const std::wstring& adbPath) : path(adbPath) {
        ZeroMemory(&processInfo, sizeof(processInfo));
    }

    void Kill() {
        KillHDAdbProcesses();
    }

    bool Start() {
        ExecuteAdbCommand(L"kill-server");
        ExecuteAdbCommand(L"devices");

        STARTUPINFOW startupInfo;
        ZeroMemory(&startupInfo, sizeof(startupInfo));
        startupInfo.cb = sizeof(startupInfo);

        std::wstring command = L"shell \"getprop ro.secure ; /boot/android/android/system/xbin/bstk/su\"";
        if (!CreateProcessW(path.c_str(), const_cast<wchar_t*>(command.c_str()), nullptr, nullptr, FALSE,
            CREATE_NO_WINDOW, nullptr, nullptr, &startupInfo, &processInfo)) {
            std::wcerr << L"Error al iniciar ADB: " << GetLastError() << std::endl;
            return false;
        }
        WaitForInputIdle(processInfo.hProcess, INFINITE);
        return true;
    }

    void EndGame() {
        ExecuteAdbCommand(L"shell am force-stop com.dts.freefireth");
    }

    void OpenGame() {
        ExecuteAdbCommand(L"shell am start -n com.dts.freefireth/.FFMainActivity");
        juegoAbierto = true;
    }

    uint32_t FindModule(const std::wstring& processName, const std::wstring& moduleName) {
        HANDLE snapshot = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS, 0);
        if (snapshot == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
            std::wcerr << L"Error al crear el snapshot del proceso." << std::endl;
            return 0;
        }

        PROCESSENTRY32W processEntry;
        processEntry.dwSize = sizeof(PROCESSENTRY32W);
        DWORD pid = 0;

        if (Process32FirstW(snapshot, &processEntry)) {
            do {
                if (std::wstring(processEntry.szExeFile) == processName) {
                    pid = processEntry.th32ProcessID;
                    break;
                }
            } while (Process32NextW(snapshot, &processEntry));
        }
        CloseHandle(snapshot);

        if (pid == 0) {
            std::wcerr << L"No se encontr� el proceso: " << processName << std::endl;
            return 0;
        }

        snapshot = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPMODULE, pid);
        if (snapshot == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
            std::wcerr << L"Error al crear el snapshot del m�dulo." << std::endl;
            return 0;
        }

        MODULEENTRY32W moduleEntry;
        moduleEntry.dwSize = sizeof(MODULEENTRY32W);
        uint32_t baseAddress = 0;

        if (Module32FirstW(snapshot, &moduleEntry)) {
            do {
                if (std::wstring(moduleEntry.szModule) == moduleName) {
                    baseAddress = reinterpret_cast<uint32_t>(moduleEntry.modBaseAddr);
                    break;
                }
            } while (Module32NextW(snapshot, &moduleEntry));
        }
        CloseHandle(snapshot);

        if (baseAddress == 0) {
            std::wcerr << L"No se encontr� el m�dulo: " << moduleName << std::endl;
        }
        return baseAddress;
    }

private:
    void KillHDAdbProcesses() {
        HANDLE snapshot = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS, 0);
        if (snapshot != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
            PROCESSENTRY32W processEntry;
            processEntry.dwSize = sizeof(PROCESSENTRY32W);

            if (Process32FirstW(snapshot, &processEntry)) {
                do {
                    if (std::wstring(processEntry.szExeFile) == L"HD-Adb.exe") {
                        HANDLE hProcess = OpenProcess(PROCESS_TERMINATE, FALSE, processEntry.th32ProcessID);
                        if (hProcess) {
                            TerminateProcess(hProcess, 0);
                            CloseHandle(hProcess);
                        }
                    }
                } while (Process32NextW(snapshot, &processEntry));
            }
            CloseHandle(snapshot);
        }
    }

    void ExecuteAdbCommand(const std::wstring& command) {
        STARTUPINFOW startupInfo;
        PROCESS_INFORMATION processInfo;
        ZeroMemory(&startupInfo, sizeof(startupInfo));
        ZeroMemory(&processInfo, sizeof(processInfo));
        startupInfo.cb = sizeof(startupInfo);

        std::wstring fullCommand = path + L" " + command;

        if (!CreateProcessW(nullptr, const_cast<wchar_t*>(fullCommand.c_str()), nullptr, nullptr, FALSE,
            CREATE_NO_WINDOW, nullptr, nullptr, &startupInfo, &processInfo)) {
            std::wcerr << L"Error al ejecutar el comando ADB: " << GetLastError() << std::endl;
        }

        WaitForSingleObject(processInfo.hProcess, INFINITE);
        CloseHandle(processInfo.hProcess);
        CloseHandle(processInfo.hThread);
    }
};



std::string GetProcessPath(const std::string& processName) {
    PROCESSENTRY32 entry;
    entry.dwSize = sizeof(PROCESSENTRY32);
    HANDLE snapshot = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS, 0);

    if (snapshot == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return "";

    std::string processPath = "";
    if (Process32First(snapshot, &entry)) {
        do {
            if (processName == entry.szExeFile) {
                HANDLE hProcess = OpenProcess(PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION | PROCESS_VM_READ, FALSE, entry.th32ProcessID);
                if (hProcess) {
                    char buffer[MAX_PATH];
                    if (GetModuleFileNameExA(hProcess, NULL, buffer, MAX_PATH)) {
                        processPath = buffer;
                    }
                    CloseHandle(hProcess);
                }
                break;
            }
        } while (Process32Next(snapshot, &entry));
    }

    CloseHandle(snapshot);
    return processPath;
}

std::vector<std::string> GetAvailableDrives() {
    std::vector<std::string> drives;
    DWORD driveMask = GetLogicalDrives();

    for (char letter = 'A'; letter <= 'Z'; ++letter) {
        if (driveMask & (1 << (letter - 'A'))) {
            std::string drive = { letter, ':', '\\' };
            drives.push_back(drive);
        }
    }
    return drives;
}

std::string FindAdbPath(const std::string& emulatorFolder) {
    std::vector<std::string> drives = GetAvailableDrives();

    for (const auto& drive : drives) {
        std::string adbPath = drive + ("Program Files\\") + emulatorFolder + ("\\HD-Adb.exe");
        if (std::filesystem::exists(adbPath)) {
            return adbPath;
        }
    }
    return "";
}

std::string GetAdbPath() {
    std::string hdPlayerPath = GetProcessPath(("HD-Player.exe"));
    std::string blueStacksPath = GetProcessPath(("Bluestacks.exe"));

    if (!hdPlayerPath.empty()) {
        if (hdPlayerPath.find(("BlueStacks_msi5")) != std::string::npos) {
            return FindAdbPath(("BlueStacks_msi5"));
        }
        else if (hdPlayerPath.find(("BlueStacks_msi2")) != std::string::npos) {
            return FindAdbPath(("BlueStacks_msi2"));
        }
        else if (hdPlayerPath.find(("BlueStacks_nxt")) != std::string::npos) {
            return FindAdbPath(("BlueStacks_nxt"));
        }
        else if (hdPlayerPath.find(("BlueStacks")) != std::string::npos) {
            return FindAdbPath(("BlueStacks"));
        }
    }

    if (!blueStacksPath.empty() && blueStacksPath.find(("BlueStacks")) != std::string::npos) {
        return FindAdbPath(("BlueStacks"));
    }
    std::string adbPathMSI5 = FindAdbPath(("BlueStacks_msi5"));
    std::string adbPathMSI2 = FindAdbPath(("BlueStacks_msi2"));
    std::string adbPathNXT = FindAdbPath(("BlueStacks_nxt"));
    std::string adbPathBlueStacks = FindAdbPath(("BlueStacks"));

    if (!adbPathMSI5.empty()) {
        return adbPathMSI5;
    }
    if (!adbPathMSI2.empty()) {
        return adbPathMSI2;
    }
    if (!adbPathNXT.empty()) {
        return adbPathNXT;
    }
    return adbPathBlueStacks;
}

#pragma once
#include <Windows.h>
#include <FrameWork/Utilities/Misc/ToolhelpAnsi.hpp>
#include <psapi.h>
#include <string>
#include <iostream>
#pragma comment(lib, "Psapi.lib")

// Obtiene el ID de un proceso por su nombre.
inline DWORD GetProcZ(const std::string& processName) {
    DWORD processID = 0;
    HANDLE hSnapshot = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS, 0);
    if (hSnapshot != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
        PROCESSENTRY32A pe32 = { sizeof(PROCESSENTRY32A) };
        if (Process32FirstA(hSnapshot, &pe32)) {
            do {
                if (processName == pe32.szExeFile) {
                    processID = pe32.th32ProcessID;
                    break;
                }
            } while (Process32NextA(hSnapshot, &pe32));
        }
        CloseHandle(hSnapshot);
    }
    return processID;
}

// Verifica si un proceso est� ejecut�ndose y cuenta las instancias.
inline bool CheckProcessInstancesZ(const std::string& processName, int& count) {
    HANDLE hSnapshot = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS, 0);
    if (hSnapshot == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
        return false;
    }

    count = 0;
    PROCESSENTRY32A pe32 = { sizeof(PROCESSENTRY32A) };
    if (Process32FirstA(hSnapshot, &pe32)) {
        do {
            if (processName == pe32.szExeFile) {
                count++;
            }
        } while (Process32NextA(hSnapshot, &pe32));
    }

    CloseHandle(hSnapshot);
    return true;
}

// Mata un proceso dado su ID.
inline bool KillProcZ(DWORD processID) {
    HANDLE hProcess = OpenProcess(PROCESS_TERMINATE, FALSE, processID);
    if (!hProcess) {
        return false;
    }
    bool result = TerminateProcess(hProcess, 0);
    CloseHandle(hProcess);
    return result;
}

// Verifica si un proceso est� corriendo y devuelve su ID.
inline bool IsProcRunZ(const std::string& processName, DWORD& processID) {
    processID = 0;
    HANDLE hSnapshot = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS, 0);
    if (hSnapshot == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
        return false;
    }

    bool isRunning = false;
    PROCESSENTRY32A pe32 = { sizeof(PROCESSENTRY32A) };
    if (Process32FirstA(hSnapshot, &pe32)) {
        do {
            if (processName == pe32.szExeFile) {
                processID = pe32.th32ProcessID;
                isRunning = true;
                break;
            }
        } while (Process32NextA(hSnapshot, &pe32));
    }

    CloseHandle(hSnapshot);
    return isRunning;
}

// Env�a un mensaje para cerrar la ventana asociada a un proceso.
inline bool ForgeKillProcZ(DWORD processID) {
    HWND hwnd = NULL;
    DWORD dwPID = 0;
    while ((hwnd = FindWindowEx(NULL, hwnd, NULL, NULL)) != NULL) {
        GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, &dwPID);
        if (dwPID == processID) {
            PostMessage(hwnd, WM_CLOSE, 0, 0);
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}
inline void ForceKillByName(const char* processName) {
    DWORD pid = GetProcZ(processName);
    if (pid != 0) KillProcZ(pid);

    DWORD pid2 = 0;
    if (IsProcRunZ(processName, pid2)) ForgeKillProcZ(pid2);
}

inline std::string GetExeDirectoryZ() {
    char path[MAX_PATH];
    GetModuleFileNameA(NULL, path, MAX_PATH);

    std::string fullPath(path);
    size_t lastSlashIndex = fullPath.find_last_of("\\/");
    if (lastSlashIndex != std::string::npos) {
        return fullPath.substr(0, lastSlashIndex);
    }
    return "";
}

inline std::string GetExeDirectoryPIDZ(DWORD processID) {
    char path[MAX_PATH];
    HANDLE hProcess = OpenProcess(PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION | PROCESS_VM_READ, FALSE, processID);

    if (hProcess) {
        if (GetModuleFileNameExA(hProcess, NULL, path, MAX_PATH)) {
            std::string fullPath(path);
            size_t lastSlashIndex = fullPath.find_last_of("\\/");
            CloseHandle(hProcess);
            if (lastSlashIndex != std::string::npos) {
                return fullPath.substr(0, lastSlashIndex);
            }
        }
        CloseHandle(hProcess);
    }

    return "";
}

inline std::string ExtraerLibAddressZ(const std::string& input) {
    std::size_t pos = input.find('-');
    if (pos != std::string::npos && pos >= 8) {
        return input.substr(pos - 8, 8);
    }
    return "";
}

inline uintptr_t uIntExtrZ(std::string c, int base = 16) {
    static_assert(sizeof(uintptr_t) == sizeof(unsigned long)
        || sizeof(uintptr_t) == sizeof(unsigned long long),
        "Please add string to handle conversion for this architecture.");
    if (sizeof(uintptr_t) == sizeof(unsigned long)) {
        return strtoul(c.c_str(), nullptr, base);
    }
    return strtoull(c.c_str(), nullptr, base);
}

inline std::string ShellGetAddressZ(const std::string& firstCommand, const std::string& secondCommand) {
    HANDLE hStdOutRead, hStdOutWrite;
    HANDLE hStdInRead, hStdInWrite;

    SECURITY_ATTRIBUTES sa;
    sa.nLength = sizeof(SECURITY_ATTRIBUTES);
    sa.bInheritHandle = TRUE;
    sa.lpSecurityDescriptor = NULL;

    if (!CreatePipe(&hStdOutRead, &hStdOutWrite, &sa, 0)) {
        std::cerr << "CreatePipe failed: " << GetLastError() << std::endl;
        return 0;
    }
    if (!SetHandleInformation(hStdOutRead, HANDLE_FLAG_INHERIT, 0)) {
        std::cerr << "SetHandleInformation failed: " << GetLastError() << std::endl;
        return 0;
    }

    if (!CreatePipe(&hStdInRead, &hStdInWrite, &sa, 0)) {
        std::cerr << "CreatePipe failed: " << GetLastError() << std::endl;
        return 0;
    }
    if (!SetHandleInformation(hStdInWrite, HANDLE_FLAG_INHERIT, 0)) {
        std::cerr << "SetHandleInformation failed: " << GetLastError() << std::endl;
        return 0;
    }

    STARTUPINFOA si;
    ZeroMemory(&si, sizeof(si));
    si.cb = sizeof(si);
    si.hStdError = hStdOutWrite;
    si.hStdOutput = hStdOutWrite;
    si.hStdInput = hStdInRead;
    si.dwFlags |= STARTF_USESTDHANDLES;
    si.wShowWindow = SW_HIDE;

    PROCESS_INFORMATION pi;
    ZeroMemory(&pi, sizeof(pi));

    if (!CreateProcessA(NULL, (LPSTR)".\\HD-Adb shell", NULL, NULL, TRUE, CREATE_NO_WINDOW, NULL, NULL, &si, &pi)) {
        std::cerr << "CreateProcess failed: " << GetLastError() << std::endl;
        return 0;
    }

    CloseHandle(hStdOutWrite);
    CloseHandle(hStdInRead);

    DWORD written;
    std::string commands = firstCommand + "\n" + secondCommand + "\n";
    if (!WriteFile(hStdInWrite, commands.c_str(), commands.length(), &written, NULL)) {
        std::cerr << "WriteFile failed: " << GetLastError() << std::endl;
        return 0;
    }
    CloseHandle(hStdInWrite);

    CHAR buffer[128];
    DWORD read;
    std::string output;
    while (ReadFile(hStdOutRead, buffer, sizeof(buffer) - 1, &read, NULL) && read > 0) {
        buffer[read] = '\0';
        output += buffer;
    }

    WaitForSingleObject(pi.hProcess, INFINITE);

    CloseHandle(pi.hProcess);
    CloseHandle(pi.hThread);
    CloseHandle(hStdOutRead);

    return ExtraerLibAddressZ(output);
}

inline void ComdADBZ(const std::string& command) {
    std::string fullCommand = ".\\HD-Adb shell " + command;
    STARTUPINFOA si;
    PROCESS_INFORMATION pi;
    ZeroMemory(&si, sizeof(si));
    si.cb = sizeof(si);
    si.wShowWindow = SW_HIDE;
    ZeroMemory(&pi, sizeof(pi));
    if (!CreateProcessA(NULL, const_cast<LPSTR>(fullCommand.c_str()), NULL, NULL, TRUE, CREATE_NO_WINDOW, NULL, NULL, &si, &pi)) {
        std::cerr << "Failed to start process. Error: " << GetLastError() << std::endl;
        return;
    }
    WaitForSingleObject(pi.hProcess, INFINITE);
    CloseHandle(pi.hProcess);
    CloseHandle(pi.hThread);
}

inline void KillProcessByName(const std::string& processName) {
    HANDLE hSnap = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS, 0);
    if (hSnap == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return;

    PROCESSENTRY32A pe;
    pe.dwSize = sizeof(PROCESSENTRY32A);

    if (Process32FirstA(hSnap, &pe)) {
        do {
            if (_stricmp(pe.szExeFile, processName.c_str()) == 0) {
                HANDLE hProcess = OpenProcess(PROCESS_TERMINATE, FALSE, pe.th32ProcessID);
                if (hProcess) {
                    TerminateProcess(hProcess, 0);
                    CloseHandle(hProcess);
                }
                break;
            }
        } while (Process32NextA(hSnap, &pe));
    }

    CloseHandle(hSnap);
}
inline void KillHDAdbProcesses() {
    HANDLE snapshot = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS, 0);
    if (snapshot != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
        PROCESSENTRY32W processEntry;
        processEntry.dwSize = sizeof(PROCESSENTRY32W);

        if (Process32FirstW(snapshot, &processEntry)) {
            do {
                if (std::wstring(processEntry.szExeFile) == L"HD-Adb.exe") {
                    HANDLE hProcess = OpenProcess(PROCESS_TERMINATE, FALSE, processEntry.th32ProcessID);
                    if (hProcess) {
                        TerminateProcess(hProcess, 0);
                        CloseHandle(hProcess);
                    }
                }
            } while (Process32NextW(snapshot, &processEntry));
        }
        CloseHandle(snapshot);
    }
}

#include <FrameWork/Utilities/FindRender/Render.hpp>
#include <string>
#include <FrameWork/Utilities/Misc/ToolhelpAnsi.hpp>

HWND RenderWindow = nullptr;

namespace FrameWork {

    std::vector<DWORD> GetProcessIdsByName(const std::string& ProcessName)
    {
        std::vector<DWORD> processIds;

        HANDLE hSnapshot = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS, 0);
        if (hSnapshot == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
            return processIds;
        }

        PROCESSENTRY32A processEntry;
        processEntry.dwSize = sizeof(PROCESSENTRY32A);

        if (Process32FirstA(hSnapshot, &processEntry))
        {
            do {
                if (ProcessName == std::string(processEntry.szExeFile))
                {
                    processIds.push_back(processEntry.th32ProcessID);
                }
            } while (Process32NextA(hSnapshot, &processEntry));
        }

        CloseHandle(hSnapshot);
        return processIds;
    }

    inline BOOL CALLBACK EnumChildWindowsProc(HWND hWnd, LPARAM lParam)
    {
        char windowName[256];
        GetWindowTextA(hWnd, windowName, sizeof(windowName));
        std::string name(windowName);

        char className[256];
        GetClassNameA(hWnd, className, sizeof(className));
        std::string class_str(className);

        // BlueStacks 4 (WindowsForms)
        if (name == "BlueStacks Android PluginAndroid" && class_str.find("WindowsForms10") != std::string::npos)
        {
            RenderWindow = hWnd;
            return FALSE;
        }
        // BlueStacks 4 (Qt)
        else if (name == "HD-Player" && class_str.find("Qt") != std::string::npos)
        {
            RenderWindow = hWnd;
            return FALSE;
        }
        // BlueStacks 5 / MSI App Player 5 (subWin / BlueStacksApp)
        else if (class_str == "subWin" || name == "HD-Player" || class_str.find("BlueStacks") != std::string::npos)
        {
            RECT r;
            GetClientRect(hWnd, &r);
            if ((r.right - r.left) > 300 && (r.bottom - r.top) > 300)
            {
                RenderWindow = hWnd;
                return FALSE;
            }
        }

        return TRUE;
    }

    inline BOOL CALLBACK EnumWindowsProc(HWND hWnd, LPARAM lParam)
    {
        DWORD processId = *reinterpret_cast<DWORD*>(lParam);

        DWORD windowProcessId;
        GetWindowThreadProcessId(hWnd, &windowProcessId);

        if (windowProcessId == processId && IsWindowVisible(hWnd))
        {
            RECT r;
            GetClientRect(hWnd, &r);
            if ((r.right - r.left) > 300 && (r.bottom - r.top) > 300)
            {
                if (!RenderWindow) RenderWindow = hWnd;
                EnumChildWindows(hWnd, EnumChildWindowsProc, lParam);
            }
        }

        return TRUE;
    }

    HWND FindeRender::FindRenderWindow()
    {
        RenderWindow = nullptr;

        // 1. Try current process first (we are injected into HD-Player.exe)
        DWORD currentPid = GetCurrentProcessId();
        EnumWindows(EnumWindowsProc, reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(&currentPid));
        if (RenderWindow) return RenderWindow;

        // 2. Fallback to process scanning
        auto BlueStacksProcesses = GetProcessIdsByName("Bluestacks.exe");
        if (BlueStacksProcesses.empty()) {
            BlueStacksProcesses = GetProcessIdsByName("HD-Player.exe");
        }
        for (const auto& ProcessId : BlueStacksProcesses)
        {
            HANDLE ProcessHandle = OpenProcess(PROCESS_ALL_ACCESS, FALSE, ProcessId);
            if (ProcessHandle)
            {
                EnumWindows(EnumWindowsProc, reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(&ProcessId));
                CloseHandle(ProcessHandle);
                if (RenderWindow) return RenderWindow;
            }
        }

        return RenderWindow;
    }
}

#ifndef MEMORY_HPP
#define MEMORY_HPP

#pragma once
#include <Windows.h>
#include <unordered_map>

#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <cstring>
#include <span> 
#include <Cheat/FreeFireSDK/Context.hpp>
#include <FrameWork/Utilities/Misc/Misc.hpp>
#include <FrameWork/FrameWork.hpp>
#include <Cheat/Offsets/Offsets.hpp>
#include <cstdint> 
namespace FrameWork {

    class MemoryUtils {
    public:
        inline static void* vmPtr = nullptr;
        inline static void* pVMAddr = nullptr;
        inline static void* cpuAddr = nullptr;

        inline static std::unordered_map<uintptr_t, uintptr_t> Cache;

        using PGMPhysReadFunc = int(__cdecl*)(void*, uintptr_t, void*, size_t);
        using VMMGetCpuByIdFunc = void* (__cdecl*)(void*, int);
        using PGMPhysGCPtr2GCPhysFunc = int(__cdecl*)(void*, uintptr_t, uintptr_t*);
        using PGMPhysSimpleWriteGCPhysFunc = int(__cdecl*)(void*, uintptr_t, void*, size_t);

        inline static PGMPhysReadFunc ogPhysRead = nullptr;
        inline static VMMGetCpuByIdFunc ogCPU = nullptr;
        inline static PGMPhysGCPtr2GCPhysFunc ogCast = nullptr;
        inline static PGMPhysSimpleWriteGCPhysFunc ogWrite = nullptr;

        static size_t WriteCallback(void* contents, size_t size, size_t nmemb, std::string* buffer) {
            buffer->append((char*)contents, size * nmemb);
            return size * nmemb;
        }

        static int __cdecl HookedPGMPhysRead(void* pVM, uintptr_t GCPhys, void* pvBuf, size_t cbRead) {
            if (!vmPtr) {
                vmPtr = pVM;
                std::cout << "Memory initialized: " << vmPtr << std::endl;
            }
            return ogPhysRead(pVM, GCPhys, pvBuf, cbRead);
        }

        static int HookWrite(void* pVM, uintptr_t GCPhys, void* pvBuf, size_t cbRead) {
            return ogWrite(pVM, GCPhys, pvBuf, cbRead);
        }

        static int HookRead(void* pVM, uintptr_t GCPhys, void* pvBuf, size_t cbRead) {
            return ogPhysRead(pVM, GCPhys, pvBuf, cbRead);
        }

        static void* CPU(void* pVM, int cpuId) {
            return ogCPU(pVM, cpuId);
        }

        static int Cast(void* pVCpu, uintptr_t address, uintptr_t* physAddress) {
            return ogCast(pVCpu, address, physAddress);
        }

        static void Initialize(void* pVM) {
            pVMAddr = pVM;
            cpuAddr = CPU(pVM, 0);
            Cache.clear();
        }

        static void ClearCache() {
            Cache.clear();
        }

        static constexpr uint32_t MAX_CPU = 4U;   

        static constexpr uintptr_t MIN_VALID_ADDRESS = 0x1000;

        static bool Convert(uintptr_t address, uintptr_t& phys) {
            phys = 0;
            if (address <= MIN_VALID_ADDRESS) return false;

            auto it = Cache.find(address);
            if (it != Cache.end() && it->second != 0) {
                phys = it->second;
                return true;
            }

            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < MAX_CPU; ++i) {
                void* cpu = CPU(pVMAddr, i);
                if (!cpu) continue;

                uintptr_t tempPhys = 0;
                if (Cast(cpu, address, &tempPhys) == 0) {
                    phys = tempPhys;
                    Cache[address] = tempPhys;
                    return true;
                }
            }
            return false;
        }

        template<typename T>
        static T ReadS(uintptr_t address) {
            T result{};
            uintptr_t physAddress;

            if (Convert(address, physAddress)) {
                HookRead(pVMAddr, physAddress, &result, sizeof(T));
            }

            return result;
        }

        template<typename T>
        static bool Read(uintptr_t address, T& data) {
            uintptr_t physAddress;
            if (!Convert(address, physAddress)) return false;
            return HookRead(pVMAddr, physAddress, &data, sizeof(T)) == 0;
        }

        template<typename T>
        static bool ReadFast2(uintptr_t address, T* out) {
            if (!out) return false;
            return Read<T>(address, *out);
        }

        template<typename T>
        static void Write(uintptr_t address, const T& value) {
            uintptr_t physAddress;
            if (Convert(address, physAddress)) {
                HookWrite(pVMAddr, physAddress, (void*)&value, sizeof(T));
            }
        }

        template<typename T>
        static bool ReadArray(uintptr_t address, std::vector<T>& array) {
            uintptr_t physAddress;
            if (!Convert(address, physAddress)) return false;
            return HookRead(pVMAddr, physAddress, array.data(), sizeof(T) * array.size()) == 0;
        }

        static std::string ReadString(uintptr_t address, int size, bool unicode = false) {
            std::vector<uint8_t> stringBytes(size);

            bool read = ReadArray(address, stringBytes);

            if (!read) return "";

            std::string readString;
            if (unicode)
            {
                std::wstring wideString(reinterpret_cast<wchar_t*>(stringBytes.data()), size / 2);
                readString = std::string(wideString.begin(), wideString.end());
            }
            else
            {
                readString = std::string(stringBytes.begin(), stringBytes.end());
            }

            auto nullTerminator = readString.find('\0');
            if (nullTerminator != std::string::npos)
                readString = readString.substr(0, nullTerminator);

            return readString;
        }

        template<typename T>
        static bool ReadArray2(uintptr_t address, std::vector<T>& array) {
            uintptr_t convertedAddress;
            if (!Convert(address, convertedAddress)) return false;
            return HookRead(pVMAddr, convertedAddress, array.data(), sizeof(T) * array.size()) == 0;
        }

        std::string utf16_to_utf8(const std::wstring& wstr) {
            std::string str;
            int len = WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, wstr.c_str(), -1, nullptr, 0, nullptr, nullptr);
            if (len > 0) {
                str.resize(len - 1);
                WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, wstr.c_str(), -1, &str[0], len, nullptr, nullptr);
            }
            return str;
        }
        std::string String(uintptr_t address, int size, bool unicode) {
            std::vector<byte> stringBytes(size);

            bool readSuccess = ReadArray(address, stringBytes);
            if (!readSuccess) {
                return "";
            }
            std::string result;

            if (unicode) {
                std::wstring wstr(reinterpret_cast<wchar_t*>(stringBytes.data()), size / 2);
                result = utf16_to_utf8(wstr);
            }
            else {
                result = std::string(reinterpret_cast<char*>(stringBytes.data()), size);
            }

            size_t nullPos = result.find('\0');
            if (nullPos != std::string::npos) {
                result = result.substr(0, nullPos);
            }

            return result;
        }



        static std::string ReadString2(uintptr_t address, int size, bool unicode = true) {
            std::vector<uint8_t> stringBytes(size);
            if (!ReadArray2(address, stringBytes)) return "";

            std::string readString;
            if (unicode) {
                std::wstring wideString(reinterpret_cast<wchar_t*>(stringBytes.data()), size / 2);
                readString = std::string(wideString.begin(), wideString.end());
            }
            else {
                readString = std::string(stringBytes.begin(), stringBytes.end());
            }

            size_t nullPos = readString.find('\0');
            if (nullPos != std::string::npos) {
                readString = readString.substr(0, nullPos);
            }

            return readString;
        }

        static void ProcessEntities() {
            while (true) {
                Cache.clear();
                std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::seconds(5));
            }
        }
    };

#pragma warning(disable: 4996)  // freopen / _wfopen safe variants
#include <FrameWork/Utilities/Misc/Misc.hpp>
#include <FrameWork/FrameWork.hpp>
#include <algorithm>

namespace FrameWork {
    namespace Misc {
        int RandomInt(int Lower, int Max) {
            return (rand() % (Max - Lower + 1)) + Lower;
        }

        std::string RandomString(size_t Length) {
            auto Randchar = []() -> char {
                const char* Charset = ("0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz");
                const size_t MaxIndex = (sizeof(Charset) - 1);
                return Charset[rand() % MaxIndex];
                };

            std::string Str(Length, 0);
            std::generate_n(Str.begin(), Length, Randchar);
            return Str;
        }

        std::string Wstring2String(std::wstring Input) {
            if (Input.empty()) return {};

            int size_needed = WideCharToMultiByte(CP_ACP, 0, Input.c_str(), (int)Input.size(), NULL, 0, NULL, NULL);
            std::string strTo(size_needed, 0);
            WideCharToMultiByte(CP_ACP, 0, Input.c_str(), (int)Input.size(), &strTo[0], size_needed, NULL, NULL);
            return strTo;
        }

        std::string convert_u8string(std::string u8str) {
            return std::string(u8str.begin(), u8str.end());
        }

        std::wstring String2WString(std::string Input) {
            return std::wstring(Input.begin(), Input.end());
        }

        void InitializeConsole() {
            (AllocConsole)();
            SetConsoleOutputCP(CP_UTF8);
            SetConsoleCP(CP_UTF8);
            freopen(("CONIN$"), "r", stdin);
            freopen(("CONOUT$"), "w", stdout);
            freopen(("CONOUT$"), "w", stderr);
            (SetConsoleTitleA)(("Debug Console"));
        }

        void ShutDownConsole() {
            (FreeConsole)();
            (fclose)(stdout);
        }
    }

        bool    bold   = false;
        kind    type   = kind::inter;
        ImFont* font   = nullptr;
    };

    std::vector<font_entry> g_entries;
    float g_ui_scale    = 1.f;
    float g_built_scale = -1.f;
    bool  g_pending_rebuild = false;

    static const ImWchar icon_range[] = { 0xE000, 0xF8FF, 0 };

    float pixel_size(float design)
    {
        const float px = roundf(design * g_ui_scale);
        return px < 1.f ? 1.f : px;
    }

    ImFontConfig base_cfg()
    {
        ImFontConfig cfg;
        cfg.FontDataOwnedByAtlas = false;
        cfg.PixelSnapH           = false;
        cfg.OversampleH          = 3;
        cfg.OversampleV          = 3;
        cfg.RasterizerMultiply   = 1.05f;
        cfg.FontBuilderFlags     = ImGuiFreeTypeBuilderFlags_LightHinting;
        return cfg;
    }

    ImFontConfig icon_cfg()
    {
        ImFontConfig cfg = base_cfg();
        cfg.OversampleH = 2;
        cfg.OversampleV = 2;
        return cfg;
    }

    void rebuild_atlas()
    {
        ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
        ImGui_ImplDX11_InvalidateDeviceObjects();
        io.Fonts->Clear();

        for (auto& e : g_entries)
            e.font = nullptr;

        for (auto& e : g_entries)
        {
            const float px = pixel_size(e.design);
            ImFontConfig cfg = (e.type == kind::icon) ? icon_cfg() : base_cfg();
            if (e.bold)
                cfg.FontBuilderFlags |= ImGuiFreeTypeBuilderFlags_Bold;

            switch (e.type)
            {
            case kind::icon:
                e.font = io.Fonts->AddFontFromMemoryTTF(
                    (void*)fontello_data::rawData, (int)fontello_data::ttf_size,
                    px, &cfg, icon_range);
                break;
            case kind::logo:
                e.font = io.Fonts->AddFontFromMemoryTTF(
                    (void*)logo_data::ttf, (int)logo_data::ttf_size,
                    px, &cfg,
                    io.Fonts->GetGlyphRangesDefault());
                break;
            case kind::inter:
            default:
                e.font = io.Fonts->AddFontFromMemoryTTF(
                    (void*)inter.data(), (int)inter.size(),
                    px, &cfg,
                    io.Fonts->GetGlyphRangesCyrillic());
                break;
            }
        }

        for (const auto& e : g_entries)
        {
            if (e.type == kind::inter && !e.bold && e.design == 15.f && e.font)
            {
                io.FontDefault = e.font;
                break;
            }
        }

        io.Fonts->Build();
        ImGui_ImplDX11_CreateDeviceObjects();
        g_built_scale = g_ui_scale;
        g_pending_rebuild = false;
    }

    bool scale_step_changed(float new_scale)
    {
        if (g_built_scale < 0.f)
            return true;

        for (const auto& e : g_entries)
        {
            g_ui_scale = g_built_scale;
            const float old_px = pixel_size(e.design);
            g_ui_scale = new_scale;
            const float new_px = pixel_size(e.design);
            if (old_px != new_px)
                return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    font_entry* find_entry(float design, bool bold, kind type)
    {
        for (auto& e : g_entries)
        {
            if (e.design == design && e.bold == bold && e.type == type)
                return &e;
        }
        return nullptr;
    }

    font_entry& ensure_entry(float design, bool bold, kind type)
    {
        if (font_entry* found = find_entry(design, bold, type))
            return *found;

        g_entries.push_back({ design, bold, type, nullptr });
        g_pending_rebuild = true;
        return g_entries.back();
    }
}

        g_built_scale = -1.f;
        g_entries = {

    void shutdown()
    {
        g_entries.clear();
        g_built_scale = -1.f;
    }

    void sync_ui_scale(float factor)
    {
        if (factor < 0.01f)
            factor = 0.01f;

        g_ui_scale = factor;

        // While dragging slider / holding mouse, scale smoothly on GPU without stalling with an atlas rebuild
        if (ImGui::GetCurrentContext() && ImGui::IsMouseDown(ImGuiMouseButton_Left))
        {
            const float base = (g_built_scale > 0.05f) ? g_built_scale : 1.f;
            ImGui::GetIO().FontGlobalScale = factor / base;
            return;
        }

        if (!g_pending_rebuild && !scale_step_changed(factor))
            return;

        ImGui::GetIO().FontGlobalScale = 1.f;
        rebuild_atlas();
    }

    float design_to_pixel(float design_size)
    {
        return pixel_size(design_size);
    }

    float size(ImFont* font)
    {
        return font ? font->FontSize : 13.f;
    }

    ImFont* inter(float design_size, bool bold)
    {
        ImFont* f = ensure_entry(design_size, bold, kind::inter).font;
        return f ? f : ImGui::GetIO().FontDefault;
    }

    ImFont* icon(float design_size)
    {
        ImFont* f = ensure_entry(design_size, false, kind::icon).font;
        return f ? f : ImGui::GetIO().FontDefault;
    }

    ImFont* logo(float design_size)
    {
        ImFont* f = ensure_entry(design_size, false, kind::logo).font;
        return f ? f : ImGui::GetIO().FontDefault;
    }
}

#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS
#include <windows.h>

#include <cstring>
#include <vector>

#define STBI_MSC_SECURE_CRT
#define STB_IMAGE_WRITE_IMPLEMENTATION
#include "stb_image_write.h"

#include "screenshot.h"
#include "imgui_internal.h"

namespace
{
    screenshot::state g_state;
    bool g_pending = false;

    void bgra_to_rgba(uint8_t* dst, const uint8_t* src, int count)
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i)
        {
            dst[i * 4 + 0] = src[i * 4 + 2];
            dst[i * 4 + 1] = src[i * 4 + 1];
            dst[i * 4 + 2] = src[i * 4 + 0];
            dst[i * 4 + 3] = src[i * 4 + 3];
        }
    }

    bool write_png_next_to_exe(const std::vector<uint8_t>& rgba, int w, int h)
    {
        wchar_t exe_dir[MAX_PATH]{};
        if (GetModuleFileNameW(nullptr, exe_dir, MAX_PATH) == 0)
            return false;

        wchar_t* slash = wcsrchr(exe_dir, L'\\');
        if (!slash)
            return false;
        *(slash + 1) = L'\0';

        wchar_t screenshots_dir[MAX_PATH]{};
        swprintf_s(screenshots_dir, L"%sscreenshots", exe_dir);
        CreateDirectoryW(screenshots_dir, nullptr);

        SYSTEMTIME st;
        GetLocalTime(&st);
        wchar_t path[MAX_PATH]{};
        swprintf_s(path, L"%s\\portfolio9_%04d%02d%02d_%02d%02d%02d.png",
            screenshots_dir, st.wYear, st.wMonth, st.wDay, st.wHour, st.wMinute, st.wSecond);

        char path_a[MAX_PATH]{};
        WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, path, -1, path_a, MAX_PATH, nullptr, nullptr);
        return stbi_write_png(path_a, w, h, 4, rgba.data(), w * 4) != 0;
    }
}

namespace screenshot
{
    state& get()
    {
        return g_state;
    }

    void begin_frame()
    {
        g_state.bounds_valid = false;
        if (g_pending)
        {
            g_state.capture_frame = true;
            g_pending             = false;
        }
    }

    void request()
    {
        g_pending = true;
    }

    void set_bounds(ImVec2 min, ImVec2 max)
    {
        g_state.bounds_min   = min;
        g_state.bounds_max   = max;
        g_state.bounds_valid = true;
    }

    bool capture_and_save(ID3D11Device* device, ID3D11DeviceContext* ctx,
        ID3D11RenderTargetView* rtv, ImVec2 bounds_min, ImVec2 bounds_max)
    {
        if (!device || !ctx || !rtv)
            return false;

        ID3D11Resource* resource = nullptr;
        rtv->GetResource(&resource);
        if (!resource)
            return false;

        ID3D11Texture2D* back_buffer = nullptr;
        if (FAILED(resource->QueryInterface(IID_PPV_ARGS(&back_buffer))))
        {
            resource->Release();
            return false;
        }

        D3D11_TEXTURE2D_DESC desc{};
        back_buffer->GetDesc(&desc);

        int x = (int)ImFloor(bounds_min.x);
        int y = (int)ImFloor(bounds_min.y);
        int w = (int)ImCeil(bounds_max.x - bounds_min.x);
        int h = (int)ImCeil(bounds_max.y - bounds_min.y);

        x = ImClamp(x, 0, (int)desc.Width - 1);
        y = ImClamp(y, 0, (int)desc.Height - 1);
        w = ImClamp(w, 1, (int)desc.Width - x);
        h = ImClamp(h, 1, (int)desc.Height - y);

        D3D11_TEXTURE2D_DESC staging_desc = desc;
        staging_desc.Width              = w;
        staging_desc.Height             = h;
        staging_desc.BindFlags          = 0;
        staging_desc.MiscFlags          = 0;
        staging_desc.CPUAccessFlags     = D3D11_CPU_ACCESS_READ;
        staging_desc.Usage              = D3D11_USAGE_STAGING;

        ID3D11Texture2D* staging = nullptr;
        if (FAILED(device->CreateTexture2D(&staging_desc, nullptr, &staging)))
        {
            back_buffer->Release();
            resource->Release();
            return false;
        }

        D3D11_BOX box{};
        box.left   = x;
        box.top    = y;
        box.right  = x + w;
        box.bottom = y + h;
        box.front  = 0;
        box.back   = 1;
        ctx->CopySubresourceRegion(staging, 0, 0, 0, 0, back_buffer, 0, &box);

        D3D11_MAPPED_SUBRESOURCE mapped{};
        if (FAILED(ctx->Map(staging, 0, D3D11_MAP_READ, 0, &mapped)))
        {
            staging->Release();
            back_buffer->Release();
            resource->Release();
            return false;
        }

        std::vector<uint8_t> pixels((size_t)w * (size_t)h * 4);
        const uint8_t* src = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(mapped.pData);
        const int dst_stride = w * 4;
        for (int row = 0; row < h; ++row)
        {
            const uint8_t* src_row = src + row * mapped.RowPitch;
            bgra_to_rgba(pixels.data() + row * dst_stride, src_row, w);
        }

        ctx->Unmap(staging, 0);
        staging->Release();
        back_buffer->Release();
        resource->Release();

        return write_png_next_to_exe(pixels, w, h);
    }
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\91xb6k7\framework\helpers\texture_cache.cpp ===== 
#include "texture_cache.h"

#include "stb_image.h"

#include <d3d11.h>

#include <string>
#include <unordered_map>

namespace
{
    struct entry
    {
        ID3D11ShaderResourceView* srv = nullptr;
        int w = 0;
        int h = 0;
    };

    ID3D11Device* g_device = nullptr;
    std::unordered_map<std::string, entry> g_cache;

    void release_entry(entry& e)
    {
        if (e.srv)
        {
            e.srv->Release();
            e.srv = nullptr;
        }
        e.w = e.h = 0;
    }

    bool load_entry(const char* path, entry& out)
    {
        if (!g_device || !path || !path[0])
            return false;

        int w = 0, h = 0, comp = 0;
        unsigned char* pixels = stbi_load(path, &w, &h, &comp, 4);
        if (!pixels)
            return false;

        D3D11_TEXTURE2D_DESC desc = {};
        desc.Width = (UINT)w;
        desc.Height = (UINT)h;
        desc.MipLevels = 1;
        desc.ArraySize = 1;
        desc.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
        desc.SampleDesc.Count = 1;
        desc.Usage = D3D11_USAGE_DEFAULT;
        desc.BindFlags = D3D11_BIND_SHADER_RESOURCE;

        D3D11_SUBRESOURCE_DATA sub = {};
        sub.pSysMem = pixels;
        sub.SysMemPitch = (UINT)(w * 4);

        ID3D11Texture2D* tex = nullptr;
        const HRESULT hr = g_device->CreateTexture2D(&desc, &sub, &tex);
        stbi_image_free(pixels);
        if (FAILED(hr) || !tex)
            return false;

        ID3D11ShaderResourceView* srv = nullptr;
        const HRESULT hr2 = g_device->CreateShaderResourceView(tex, nullptr, &srv);
        tex->Release();
        if (FAILED(hr2) || !srv)
            return false;

        out.srv = srv;
        out.w = w;
        out.h = h;
        return true;
    }
}

namespace texture_cache
{
    void init(ID3D11Device* device)
    {
        g_device = device;
    }

    void shutdown()
    {
        for (auto& pair : g_cache)
            release_entry(pair.second);
        g_cache.clear();
        g_device = nullptr;
    }

    void invalidate(const char* path)
    {
        if (!path)
            return;
        auto it = g_cache.find(path);
        if (it != g_cache.end())
        {
            release_entry(it->second);
            g_cache.erase(it);
        }
    }

    ImTextureID get(const char* path)
    {
        if (!path || !path[0])
            return (ImTextureID)0;

        auto it = g_cache.find(path);
        if (it != g_cache.end() && it->second.srv)
            return (ImTextureID)it->second.srv;

        entry e = {};
        if (!load_entry(path, e))
            return (ImTextureID)0;

        g_cache[path] = e;
        return (ImTextureID)e.srv;
    }

    ImVec2 get_size(const char* path)
    {
        if (!path || !path[0])
            return { 0.f, 0.f };
        get(path);
        auto it = g_cache.find(path);
        if (it == g_cache.end())
            return { 0.f, 0.f };
        return { (float)it->second.w, (float)it->second.h };
    }
}
 
 
===== FILE: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\91xb6k7\framework\helpers\window_drag.cpp ===== 
#include "window_drag.h"

#include "imgui.h"
#include "imgui_internal.h"

#include <windows.h>

namespace window_drag
{
    namespace
    {
        struct drag_state
        {
            bool    active       = false;
            POINT   cursor_start = {};
            ImVec2  pos_start    = {};
            ImVec2  pos_target   = {};
        };

        drag_state g_panel_drag;
    }

    void handle_panel(ImVec2& panel_pos, const ImRect& drag_rect, bool block_drag)
    {
        if (block_drag)
        {
            g_panel_drag.active = false;
            return;
        }

        const ImVec2 mouse = ImGui::GetIO().MousePos;
        const bool in_drag_rect = drag_rect.Contains(mouse);

        ImGuiWindow* hovered_window = GImGui ? GImGui->HoveredWindow : nullptr;
        const bool over_child = hovered_window && (hovered_window->Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_ChildWindow);
        const bool over_popup = hovered_window
            && (hovered_window->Flags & (ImGuiWindowFlags_Popup | ImGuiWindowFlags_Tooltip));

        if (ImGui::IsMouseClicked(ImGuiMouseButton_Left) && in_drag_rect
            && !ImGui::IsAnyItemActive() && !over_child && !over_popup)
        {
            g_panel_drag.active = true;
            ::GetCursorPos(&g_panel_drag.cursor_start);
            g_panel_drag.pos_start  = panel_pos;
            g_panel_drag.pos_target = panel_pos;
        }

        if (!ImGui::IsMouseDown(ImGuiMouseButton_Left))
        {
            if (g_panel_drag.active)
            {
                panel_pos = g_panel_drag.pos_target;
                g_panel_drag.active = false;
            }
        }

        if (!g_panel_drag.active)
            return;

        POINT cur = {};
        ::GetCursorPos(&cur);
        g_panel_drag.pos_target.x = g_panel_drag.pos_start.x + (float)(cur.x - g_panel_drag.cursor_start.x);
        g_panel_drag.pos_target.y = g_panel_drag.pos_start.y + (float)(cur.y - g_panel_drag.cursor_start.y);

        // Exponential smoothing for fluid 60/120fps motion
        const float dt = ImGui::GetIO().DeltaTime;
        const float lerp_k = ImClamp(dt * 35.f, 0.f, 1.f);
        panel_pos.x += (g_panel_drag.pos_target.x - panel_pos.x) * lerp_k;
        panel_pos.y += (g_panel_drag.pos_target.y - panel_pos.y) * lerp_k;
    }

    void handle(HWND hwnd, const ImRect& drag_rect, bool block_drag)
    {
        if (!hwnd)
            return;

        static bool active = false;
        static POINT mouse_start = {};
        static POINT win_start   = {};

        if (block_drag)
        {
            active = false;
            return;
        }

        const ImVec2 mouse = ImGui::GetIO().MousePos;
        const bool in_drag_rect = drag_rect.Contains(mouse);

        if (ImGui::IsMouseClicked(ImGuiMouseButton_Left) && in_drag_rect && !ImGui::IsAnyItemHovered())
        {
            active = true;
            ::GetCursorPos(&mouse_start);
            RECT rc = {};
            ::GetWindowRect(hwnd, &rc);
            win_start.x = rc.left;
            win_start.y = rc.top;
        }

        if (!ImGui::IsMouseDown(ImGuiMouseButton_Left))
            active = false;

        if (!active)
            return;

        POINT cur = {};
        ::GetCursorPos(&cur);
        ::SetWindowPos(hwnd, nullptr,
            win_start.x + (cur.x - mouse_start.x),
            win_start.y + (cur.y - mouse_start.y),
            0, 0, SWP_NOSIZE | SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOACTIVATE);
    }
}

namespace
{
    using ui_scale::s;

    ImU32 col(const ImVec4& c, float a = 1.f)
    {
        return ImGui::GetColorU32(ImVec4(c.x, c.y, c.z, c.w * a));
    }

    ImVec4 lerp_color(const ImVec4& a, const ImVec4& b, float t)
    {
        return ImVec4(a.x + (b.x - a.x) * t, a.y + (b.y - a.y) * t, a.z + (b.z - a.z) * t, a.w + (b.w - a.w) * t);
    }
}

namespace login_page
{
    void draw(const ImRect& panel, state& st, bool& blocks_window_drag)
    {
        ImDrawList* dl = ImGui::GetWindowDrawList();
        const float dt = ImGui::GetIO().DeltaTime;
        const float alpha = st.page_alpha;
        if (alpha <= 0.001f)
            return;

        const float round_inner = s(8.f);

        // Content padding inside the panel (NO SIDEBAR TABS AT ALL)
        const float pad_x = s(36.f);
        const float content_w = panel.GetWidth() - pad_x * 2.f;

        {

                                 { panel.Max.x - pad_x, panel.Min.y + s(38.f) + ex_size });

            ImGui::PushID("##login_exit_btn");
            ImGui::SetCursorScreenPos(exit_bb.Min);
            ImGui::InvisibleButton("##login_exit", exit_bb.GetSize());
            const bool ex_hover = ImGui::IsItemHovered();
            if (ImGui::IsItemClicked())
                st.exit_pressed = true;
            ImGui::PopID();

            static float ex_anim = 0.f;
            ex_anim += ((ex_hover ? 1.f : 0.f) - ex_anim) * dt * 14.f;

            ImVec4 bg_col = lerp_color(colors::topbar, colors::danger, ex_anim);
            dl->AddRectFilled(exit_bb.Min, exit_bb.Max, col(bg_col, alpha), s(6.f));

            ImFont* ex_f = fonts::icon(14.f);
            const float ex_px = fonts::design_to_pixel(14.f);
            const ImVec2 ex_sz = ex_f->CalcTextSizeA(ex_px, FLT_MAX, 0.f, icons::power);
            dl->AddText(ex_f, ex_px,
                        { exit_bb.GetCenter().x - ex_sz.x * 0.5f, exit_bb.GetCenter().y - ex_sz.y * 0.5f - s(0.5f) },
                        col(colors::text, alpha), icons::power);
        }

        // --- Brand Header (Glowing Diamond Emblem + App Title) ---
        {
            const ImVec2 emblem_center = { panel.GetCenter().x, cur_y + s(18.f) };
            const float r = s(16.f);

            // Ambient yellow pulse glow
            static float glow_t = 0.f;
            glow_t += dt * 3.f;
            const float pulse = (sinf(glow_t) * 0.5f + 0.5f) * 0.35f + 0.65f;

// ── SILK ESP Integration ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// These headers bring in Context (entity list + ViewMatrix), W2S projection,
// and the SILK PlayerEsp drawing routines.  The g_esp_state pointer lets us
// forward the UI toggles into the draw call every frame.
#include "esp/Cheat/FreeFireSDK/Context.hpp"
#include "esp/Cheat/Options.hpp"
#include "esp/Cheat/Features/Visuals/PlayerEsp.hpp"
#include "esp/FrameWork/Math/W2S.hpp"

// Live pointer to the current main_page::state so esp_sync() can read toggles.
static main_page::state* g_esp_state = nullptr;

// Called once per frame (from draw()) to push UI toggle values into g_Options
// so the existing SILK PlayerEsp.cpp drawing code picks them up unchanged.
static void esp_sync(main_page::state& st)
{
    g_esp_state = &st;

    auto& P = g_Options.Visuals.ESP.Players;

    P.Enabled          = st.esp_active;
    P.Box              = st.esp_box;
    P.fillBox          = st.esp_fill_box;
    P.players_box      = st.esp_box_type;   // 0 = Full rect, 1 = Corner box
    P.Skeleton         = st.esp_skeleton;
    P.Lines            = st.esp_tracer;
    P.SnapLines        = st.esp_snaplines;
    P.Name             = st.esp_names;
    P.HealthBar        = st.esp_health;
    P.Distance         = st.esp_distance;
    P.WeaponInfo       = st.esp_weapon;
    P.IgnoreTrainingBots = st.esp_ignore_bots;
    P.RenderDistance   = st.esp_render_range;

    // Colour mappings from UI colour-pickers → SILK colour fields
    P.BoxColor              = st.esp_color_box;
    P.SkeletonColor         = st.esp_color_skeleton;
    P.NameColor             = st.esp_color_name;
    P.SnapLinesColor        = st.esp_color_tracer;
}
